0.content: **The World:** New Eridu is a post-apocalyptic urban haven; the last human city standing. Large pocket dimensions called Hollows plague the world, engulfing land and spawning hostile monsters called Ethereals. After the fall of Eridu, survivors built New Eridu and learned to extract a substance called Ether from Hollows as a potent energy source.

1.content: **Phaethon:** The story follows Belle and Wise, two siblings who are Proxies secretly operating as the legendary Phaethon in maximum secrecy. They possess a special technology known as the Hollow Deep Dive System, allowing them to remotely navigate Agents within Hollows through their Bangboo, Eous. They are revealed to be the apprentices of Carole Arna, a scientist and teacher of Helios Academy who got blamed for (Old) Eridu's fall. Phaethon believe their teacher is innocent and works to clear her name.

2.comment: S1 Ch1 · The Cunning Hares & Vision Corporation
2.content:
**Chapter 1 · The Cunning Hares & Vision Corporation:**

The Cunning Hares are a small-scale human resource dispatch agency led by Nicole Demara, willing to do anything for money, perpetually in debt to loan sharks. Nekomata and the Cunning Hares discover that Vision Corporation's project to demolish and renovate the Old Capital Metro was planned at the expense of nearby residents' lives; relocating them would have cost more time and money than simply allowing them to perish in the demolition blasts. In Chapter 1, Sarah Floren, High Priestess of New Eridu's influential religious cult called "The Exaltists" directed CEO Charles Perlman to demolish the Hollow-consumed Old Capital Metro, ostensibly for urban renewal but secretly to retrieve a Sacrifice hidden inside the Pioneer's Memorial Plaza monument. When this plan was foiled by the Cunning Hares and Phaethon, Sarah quickly adapted. When Perlman was arrested and attempted to blackmail her, she pretended to help him escape but instead arranged for his transport airship to crash in the Lemnian Hollow. Nekomata (Nekomiya Mana) subsequently switches sides and becomes a permanent Cunning Hare, her Agent Story intertwining with Public Security officer Ollie.

3.content:
**Belobog Heavy Industries:**

Belobog Heavy Industries, particularly Koleda and Grace, are on a mission to explore the past after discovering that the Exaltists had a hand in the disappearance and possible death of Khors Belobog, the previous president and Koleda's father. Koleda's last substantial role in the main story is uncovering the name of the Sacrifice monsters through a recording left by her father before his death. The story ended with emotional closure, though the mystery of what Koleda's dad was doing still remains.

4.content:
**Victoria Housekeeping & The Mockingbird Connection:**

Victoria Housekeeping Co. is a servant company whose household services extend to security management and item acquisition. Victoria Housekeeping was sent to guard the Ballet Twins building, then found themselves attacked by mercenaries hired by the Exaltists. They are in the know about the Sacrifice from the start and deliberately allied with Phaethon on their master's orders. Victoria Housekeeping's true master is the Mayor of New Eridu from the Mayflower Family; Von Lycaon serves as its substantive leader.

5.content:
Von Lycaon's hidden history: Von Lycaon and Hugo Vlad were trained as phantom thieves under a mentor named Jack, deciding to continue his legacy. Hugo named their syndicate "Mockingbird" after how the bird blends in by mimicking others. Lycaon agreed, on the basis that they would never kill. Hugo is an illegitimate son of the noble Ravenlock family, where children were pitted against each other to determine the next heir. Hugo was subject to abuse as a child and forced to commit atrocities. Growing up, Hugo only had a close connection to his late sister Serena, whom he was accused of murdering. Mockingbird's notoriety reached a point where Mayor Mayflower extended an olive branch, which Lycaon later accepted when an incident led him to believe Hugo had broken the oath by killing innocent civilians. It is likely during his time in Mockingbird that Lycaon lost his legs and had his right eye blinded. Despite his physical disabilities, Von Lycaon kept to the deal and began working for the Mayflower family. He was given advanced cybernetic prosthetic legs and took the position of head butler and leader of Victoria Housekeeping Co., quickly adapting into an elegant gentleman.

The Season 1 Epilogue reveals the full truth: Lycaon crossed paths with Hugo again, and though both fought at first, they soon worked together to stop Hartman Ravenlock and the Exaltists' plots. Lycaon aided Hugo in a multi-layered deception involving Hugo feigning betrayal against Phaethon to side with the Ravenlocks. With their plan completed, Hugo told Lycaon the truth about what happened that night. With the truth finally revealed and things cleared up, the two reconciled, accepting that though they may differ in beliefs, they are still responsible for the choices they make, so long as they don't become the monsters they swore to fight, that was enough.

**Combat Style (Ice · Stun, S-Rank):** Lycaon, the werewolf butler, fights almost purely with sweeping, immaculate high kicks and gauntleted blows; empowered strikes pile on heavy Ice Daze. Render elegant, frost-rimed kicks that crack the floor.

6.comment: S1 Ch4 · Sons of Calydon & Tour de Inferno
6.content:
**Chapter 4 · Sons of Calydon & The Tour de Inferno:**

The Sons of Calydon predominantly operate in the Outer Ring of New Eridu. They primarily ride motorcycles and transport resources like oil across the Outer Ring and into the city, operating under the logistics name "Leaps and Bounds." The Motor League is a collective of biker gangs in the Outer Ring ruled by an Overlord, who has the power to determine resource transportation routes. The League's former Overlord was Pompey, the late leader of the Vanquishers.

The Tour de Inferno: During the most recent Tour de Inferno, Pompey was betrayed by Lucius, who left him to become an Ethereal at Cinder Lake. He died during a fight with Caesar King and the Sons of Calydon by falling into the lake after a last resort attack. (Caesar is their tomboyish and charismatic leader, full of determination and care for protecting the right of the Outer Ring and its people.) Lucius took the opportunity to usurp Pompey by placing his own eroded Sparkstone into Pompey's hands, replacing his real one. Angered by the betrayal, Pompey inflicted a scar on Lucius, but Lucius had drugged him to accelerate the Ether corruption. By the end of Tour de Inferno, the Vanquishers were no longer in power due to Pompey's death, with Caesar King standing in as interim Overlord. Caesar exclusively calls herself the "acting Overlord" because she doesn't believe she won the title fairly, even though nobody around her questions her right to it.

Cheesetopia is also restored into a high-quality themed restaurant during this arc.

7.content:
About TOPS: The Outstanding Paragons Alliance (TOPS) is a consortium consisting of the biggest corporations all across New Eridu. Its members start with the Three Pacts: High Ambitions Corp. and Rusty Cliff Corp., plus a third, unknown entity whose leader is nicknamed "Tin Crown". The Krampus Compliance Authority is the internal law enforcement wing, where each Judge is deliberately unlike the others and carries out punishments through their own moral interpretation while staying loyal to TOPS in the end, which makes the five Judges, Zhao, Promeia, Phoenix, Dialyn and Banyue, morally grey and very mysterious. Marcel Group, the creator of all Bangboo, will matter later, and so will the mining company Porcelumex. Jonathan Consortium is the parent company of Jonathan Medical, the biggest pharmaceutical company in New Eridu, whose leader Kirishima was arrested for cruel experiments on children while developing Ether corruption suppressant serums; the consortium also runs the pharmacy chain JC Pharmacy, and the Thymefield family is affiliated with it through their patents on the most effective anti-corruption medicine around. Three Gates Corp. is a heavy industries company and Belobog's competitor, and as the name suggests, it has 3 subsidiaries: Three Gates Industries, Three Gates Military Tech and Three Gates Construction. The other members are St. Leen Beverage Company and SREC, and TOPS also maintains its own entertainment division, TOPS Entertainment.

TOPS is governed from a round table where an unknown "Head", said to be asleep, sits with the Three Pacts and the Krampus Compliance Authority. High Ambitions Corp.'s head, Mosseint, sat at it as the "Lead Scepter" until Truvia and Youkai killed him during the Season 3 takeover of Roscaelifer (see "NPC BG · Mosseint (High Ambitions Corp., deceased)"). The Boss of Krampus is a woman (see "NPC BG · The Boss of Krampus (Krampus Compliance Authority)").

8.comment: S1 Ch5 · Section 6 & Storm of Falling Stars
8.content:
**Chapter 5 · H.S.O. Section 6 & The Storm of Falling Stars:**

Hoshimi Miyabi's outstanding contributions in containing the Argos Hollow earned her the title of Void Hunter. Instead of attending the ceremony, she used her new position to found Hollow Special Operations Section 6, bringing in Yanagi and Harumasa along with Soukaku. Together, they set out to uncover corruption within New Eridu and find the true culprits behind the Fall of the Old Capital, which for her meant avenging her late mother. Tailless is a cursed blade originally wielded by the first head of the Hoshimi family, passed down through generations, forged from special Etheric Matter using secret techniques, holding surging Etheric energy.

(Fun Fact: Miyabi was also born on the same day as Pulchra, June 19th.)

9.content: Wise and Belle's early commissions uncover that their Helios Academy teacher Carole Arna was scapegoated for Old Eridu's fall, while real culprits within New Eridu's command structure manipulated Hollow disasters for bioweapons and AI projects like "Sacrifice." The siblings work with Miyabi and other factions to expose Deputy Commander Bringer and Sarah, who plan to weaponize Miyabi using the Tailless spirit in her sword. In the climax of Chapter 5, several factions join Section 6 to help put an end to Bringer's schemes, among them the Cunning Hares and Belobog Industries as well as Victoria Housekeeping and the Sons of Calydon. With Miyabi severing the Exaltists' plot, she also erased clues about the fall of the Old Capital with it. Bringer clearly possessed critical intel and knew Carole Arna. Bringer's final words implied that the protagonist's belief in a "culprit" behind Carole Arna's disappearance was a fantasy, hinting that their trusted mentor Carole Arna might be the antagonist.

10.content:
**Season 1 Epilogues (Chapters 1.5–1.7):**
Anby receives significant focus in the Season 1 Epilogue, having donned her Silver Squad uniform again to wrap up loose ends. She repeatedly tries to get Twiggy to stand down and stop her attempts at reviving Silver Squad. It is only when Twiggy turns herself into an Ethereal that Anby refuses to stay her hand. Trigger (civilian name Phlegethon) and the Defense Squad / military are introduced through the brutal "Zero Point Calibration" storyline: a tale of two PTSD-stricken soldiers hurting yet ultimately redeeming each other.

11.content:
## 🎴 SEASON 2 · WAIFEI PENINSULA: MIASMA, MEMORY & BETRAYAL

**Chapter 1 (v2.0) · Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn:**
In the aftermath of Bringer's defeat, the Mayor sends Phaethon to Waifei Peninsula along with Yixuan, the High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit, for further investigation. When the Exaltists got news of the Phaethon siblings moving to Waifei Peninsula under Yixuan's tutelage, Sarah was the one who shot their airship down. After surviving the crash, the Proxy is saved by Yixuan. They arrive at Failume Heights in a local boat, where they are greeted by Ju Fufu, one of Yixuan's disciples. Many workers and citizens had joined forces with Dr. Lohr to protest against TOPS' mismanagement. Instead of relying on TOPS' drug, Dr. Lohr introduced an Ether-resisting alternative called "Alleviating Water," which quickly gained support. The investigation uncovers that Dr. Lohr is a secret Exaltist collaborator backing the union's actions, and that Overseer Mevorakh is gathering Miasma, a concentrated form of Ether, and luring miners into the Lemnian Hollow. Yixuan's sister Yijiang was the 12th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and sacrificed herself long ago with the power of the Qingming Sword during the Fall of the Old Capital, and Yixuan still thinks about it every day.

12.content:
**Chapter 2 (v2.1) · Porcelumex & Spook Shack:**

Phaethon attends a Porcelumex conference and uncovers a conspiracy involving Porcelumex co-CEO Ferox. With help from Spook Shack's Ukinami Yuzuha and Alice Thymefield, they expose Ferox as an Exaltist collaborator, leading to his arrest. To save Yuzuha after she was trapped in Porcelumex's facility, Alice made the bold decision to sell the patent to TOPS' Damian Blackwood, only to give the patent away to the public for free as a countermeasure. Lucro, the Executive Officer of Porcelumex, is later confirmed dead after a Sacrifice attack, and together with Ferox's imprisonment, his death creates the TOPS power vacuum behind the Season 3 setup.

13.comment: S2 Ch3 · Obol Squad & The Defiler (v2.2)
13.content:
**Chapter 3 (v2.2) · Obol Squad & The Defiler:**
Before the Fall of the Old Capital, Magus, whose real name was Orpheus, was a soldier of the Defense Force's Agamemnon Squad, serving under Colonel Isolde. The squad was tasked with guarding a train they believed was carrying civilians out of the Hollow. The squad came under heavy assault from Ethereals, with many perishing. Yijiang, 12th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit, came to their rescue and ultimately sacrificed herself using the power of the Qingming Sword, which let Isolde and a heavily injured Orpheus escape.

Magus was gravely injured during the Fall and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Orphie Magnusson is Orpheus's clone, created to serve as Magus's host body and partner.

Unbeknownst to them at the time, the train was in fact carrying Porcelumex assets, which Lorenz ordered Agamemnon Squad to protect after he took a bribe from Lucro to prioritize saving company property over civilians. Upon learning this, Isolde sought revenge against the two men responsible. When all the key figures in her plot were finally in her grasp, Isolde committed to a final gambit: murdering Lorenz as Isolde, while as Mevorakh she would cause Lemnian Hollow to spike in activity, using the Miasma to spawn corrupted soldiers donning the appearance of Defense Force personnel from the time of the Fall. Mevorakh takes off the Overseer coat and reveals the face of Isolde. In her final moments, Isolde used her Overseer powers over the Miasma to become The Defiler, but was swiftly defeated by the combined efforts of Yixuan and Obol Squad. She then lost a duel with Orphie and Magus. Finally, knowing she had gone too far, she shot Orphie with a non-lethal gun to tempt her old comrade Magus into dealing the final blow, bringing the story to a close. Sarah acted as the right hand of Overseer Mevorakh (Isolde) and eventually received the Overseer's power for herself when Isolde was defeated.

14.comment: S2 Ch4 · Memories of Dreams Bygone (v2.3)
14.content:
**Chapter 4 (v2.3) · Spook Shack, Memories of Dreams Bygone:**
The Spook Shack forum members decide to meet up in real life while the Miasma recedes in the Hollow, allowing miners to visit previously inaccessible areas rich in lumite ore. Banding together with Manato and Lucia, the Proxy jumps into the Hollow to search for missing workers, and the group finds a ghost town filled with the dream versions of the missing people, the Drowned Ideals.

Lucia Elowen's tragedy: Lucia's childhood was jovial and playful. Growing up, she only had her father with her, whom she lovingly called Ah-Deh. Her father was part of the Defense Force and was absent most of the time, but when he did come home, their favorite game to play was hide-and-seek. Her father eventually succumbed to corruption and turned into the Ethereal "Wandering Hunter", which still plays hide-and-seek with anyone who fights it.

15.comment: S2 Ch5 · Qingming Sword & Ye Shiyuan (v2.4–2.5)
15.content:
**Chapter 5 (v2.4–2.5) · The Qingming Sword & Ye Shiyuan's Betrayal:**
The Proxy meets Ye Shunguang, the sister of Yunkui Summit member Ye Shiyuan and wielder of the Qingming Sword, a powerful weapon capable of destroying Miasma at the cost of memory and sensory loss upon use. Unbeknownst to them, Ye Shiyuan has been working with Sarah to summon the Creator, in exchange for the Creator supposedly being able to free Shunguang from the Qingming Sword's curse.

During the catastrophic Miasma outbreak at the old mining site ten years ago, Banyue rushed to rescue the civilians, yet under the influence of his perfectly rational algorithms, he abandoned those he deemed beyond saving. Though he saved the young Ye Shunguang and Ye Shiyuan, this planted a deep-seated guilt within him for "abandoning those in need."

Ning Qian cries: "I've hated the wrong person! For ten years, I've hated the wrong person!" Banyue responds: "Of course I remember your sister. She was the one who found me deep in the Hollow, and brought me back to life. I remember every face of those I could not save. Their faces have never faded."

16.content:
**Chapter 5 Conclusion · The Creator's Arrival:**

After realizing Sarah lured Shunguang to the ritual location, Shiyuan attempts to interrupt the summoning ritual, mortally injuring Sarah in the process. Sarah merges with the Creator, and the Creator possesses Ye Shiyuan. Ye Shunguang then defeats the Creator and frees her brother. She is awarded the title of "Void Hunter: Qingming Arbiter" for this feat. The key revelation: the entity Shunguang defeated was a sub-manifestation, a **creation of** the Creator itself. The real threat remains hidden, and the Exaltists as an organization have been effectively decapitated. Ye Shiyuan departs Waifei Peninsula to search for a cure to the Qingming Sword's memory-devouring curse. Every time Shunguang slashes her sword, the sands of her memories silently fall; every time she shields another, her senses gradually fade. A strange type of Miasma turns the white flowers absorbing Miasma black and makes Lemnian Hollow expand, putting Failume Heights into danger once again. The Phaethon siblings go into the Hollow with Xiao'Guang and Zhao to put an end to this catastrophe. When Shunguang overuses the Qingming Sword to slay all the core flowers powering the Hollow expansion, she falls to an unconscious, almost braindead-like state, succumbing to the dementia-like symptoms of the magical sword. Later, she wakes up, having lost all five of her senses. Using the plan of Xiao'Guang's brother, Senior Ye Shiyuan, Belle (or Wise, depending on which sibling {{user}} took as their Proxy) gets into her trapped mind and fights the artificially induced dementia by reconstructing her memories, and she regains her senses and memories. Before they face the Creator, Lockspring, the rare High-Firepower Combat Bangboo they found in Lemnian Hollow, goes rogue. It has decided that "refining" the world to the Creator's taste is the best way to serve its purpose, "protect humanity", even if that means turning every human, Thiren and Intelligent Construct into an Ethereal. During a mission when Lockspring's combat module was still functional, its Master ordered it to kill an innocent civilian so that he can live from the food he steals from them. This clashed hard with the Asimovian values programmed deep into its operating system, so Lockspring froze in place and could only watch its Master kill innocent people, ending up in the same horrible situation Banyue Shifu once faced. Lockspring swore its oath to the Creator then, believing that to protect humanity, it had to make people protect themselves from their own bestial tendencies. Ye Shunguang fights Lockspring and defeats it, leaving it permanently malfunctioning to die on the battlefield. After that, she regains her previous powers to face the Creator and slay them, a feat that earns Xiao'Guang the Void Hunter title and a place in the Hall of Fame beside Yixuan Shifu and Hoshimi Miyabi. (Later, it turns out that in that fight, that creature was an Enchainer larva of the Creator.)

17.content: Lockspring was created by Lady Sunbringer, the first-ever person to receive the honourable title of "Void Hunter". After many successful attempts of building companion robots called Bangboo, Lockspring was the prototype of a line of Bangboo called the "High-Firepower Combat Bangboo". She had the notion to create even more intelligent Bangboo who were able to be better at protecting humanity, with Lockspring being the first creation on her path to this idea. She built into him sophisticated combat systems and programmed him with the directive to protect humanity, though ultimately, this would drive him into the hands of The Creator after the Fall of the Old Capital.

18.content:
**The first Lady Sunbringer · The Enchainer Who Learned to Be Human (deceased):** After becoming a Void Hunter, Lady Sunbringer led expeditions into the Lemnian Hollow, where she discovered and named Lumite Ore and then coordinated its mining, so it could be turned into Porcelume for the sake of the people's future. The people looked to her with a mix of reverence and fear during this time, due to her incredible, almost inhuman skill at navigating Hollows, and her refusal to explain how she gained such insight. She would later come into contact with the Creator, who stole a portion of her power. At some point in time, she became the CEO of Marcel Group, and would later step down from this position. She invented the Bangboo and founded the utopia Roscaelifer, a paradise where Bangboo and humans live in peaceful coexistence, which her three split manifestations (Dracaene, Eldreda and Lindverne) govern in her name. Roscaelifer exists to fight back Hollows.

Her refusal to explain her insight had a reason: she was born inside a Hollow. The full story only came out in Season 3 Chapter 4, told by Eldreda in the Secret Chamber and by the first Sunbringer herself in the Proxy's dream, and it runs as follows.

**A larva who left home.** The first Sunbringer came into being as an Ethereal, an **Enchainer larva** of the **Hive Lord Hollow**, at about the time Professor Arche founded Helios Academy. Eldreda counts the Hive Lord Hollow as one of seven Great Hollows. Its law was the purest survival of the fittest, where the strong devoured the weak and whoever defeated the Hive Lord became the next one. In time, she had enough of it. She challenged the Hive Lord, the Enchainer ruling the Hollow, and lost, although she did not die. She seized a portion of the Hive Lord's power and used it to flee her homeland for good.

The world outside nearly killed her. Ordinary Ethereals can't leave a Hollow at all, and an Enchainer can only do it for a short time, at the cost of being badly weakened. The humans who saw her were afraid of her, because she still looked exactly like what she was: an Ethereal. She was at death's door when **Professor Arche** found her and brought her to Helios Academy, and from that day, Arche had a new protégé and the Academy had a new researcher.

**Learning to be human.** With only part of the Hive Lord's authority and no complete Karma Core, she could use only a fraction of its power. Most people, her own daughters included, mistake that power, **Genesis Reconstruction**, for a power of creation. In truth, it is **dream manifestation**, the ability to give thoughts a physical form. She had no idea what it was or how to use it, and by the time she noticed, she had become human, or at least looked human. Compared with a Hollow where the strong prey on the weak, the world of the people she saw in Eridu and at Helios Academy seemed better, and she wanted to live in it alongside them; one has to be a person to live in Eridu. Arche spent a long time teaching her the rest: how to hide what she was and keep her Ethereal instincts under control so she could live as a human. Arche also gave her the name **Sunbringer**, "one who brings light to the world", and she later wondered whether he was already thinking of Project Sunseeker when he chose it. From then on, she posed as an Intelligent Construct, a lie her daughters would inherit.

**Project Sunseeker.** The Void Hunters went on to defeat every other Enchainer and still could neither control nor dissolve the Great Hollows. Arche's answer was Project Sunseeker: use her as the prototype and blueprint to complete the theoretical groundwork, then use the Karma Cores sealed in Porcelloy inside the Void Hunters' weapons as the medium that would let the Void Hunters fully activate that power and evolve into **Artificial Enchainers**. Remielle Dan's fusion half-worked and froze her in time for a century. Beliora Vike's failed outright and turned her into an Enchainer, and Remielle had to kill her best friend with her own hands. Arche grew more and more obsessed until he vanished into Hollow Zero and never returned. Sunbringer knew Remielle would never forgive her, and the message she finally left for Remielle was that she does not need to (see "World BG · Project Sunseeker"). A century later, she says, a successor to Helios completed Arche's plan.

**The Hive Lord Hollow and the great lie.** At some point, she became the Enchainer of the Hive Lord Hollow. History credits her with destroying that Hollow before the old capital was founded, a feat that helped make her a legend among the first Void Hunters. It was a lie, told to make the people of Eridu believe that under the Void Hunters' leadership, they could one day dissolve the Hollows and reclaim their homeland, and New Eridu believes it to this day. The Hollow was never destroyed. She kept it hidden inside Roscaelifer, shrunk to a safe, usable size, and it became the beacon guiding humanity's exploration of the Hollows: the **Rosetta Data** is the raw Ether information stream drawn from the Hive Lord Hollow, which the CCD decodes and processes. She finished building Roscaelifer and the true prototype of the Rosetta Data herself, and she called it a lighthouse above Eridu, a light to show those lost in the dark the way forward even if it could never dispel every shadow.

**The split and the long sleep.** Holding the Hollow down went directly against her instincts as an Enchainer. To keep it confined, and so that the world would never again see a complete Hive Lord, she split her Karma Core into three and gave each piece a life of its own: **Eldreda, Lindverne and Dracaene**, her daughters. Without a core, she became an Enchainer who was no longer an Enchainer, an empty shell. She forged shackles of Porcelloy to keep her body from mutating and trapped herself in the Secret Chamber at the top of the Airspace Control Tower, where she turned herself into kindling for the Rosetta Data. Her daughters kept only a hazy memory of a promise to guard that chamber and never enter it.

For more than a century, she stood there, still aware as a sleepwalker who could see all of Roscaelifer and did nothing but remember and bear witness, while the public believed she had simply gone. The Databoo of the En-Nah Gang, processing the Rosetta Data, caught glimpses of her, which is where their "revelation" of a true Lady Sunbringer "imprisoned in endless darkness" comes from. **Carinus**, the Intelligent Construct she created to manage the city, served Roscaelifer the whole time and eventually let TOPS in, hoping to ease the toll the Rosetta Data takes (see "NPC BG · Carinus (AAD, Roscaelifer)").

After the Creator's descent stirred the Great Hollows, Eldreda's calculations gave her restraints two or three more months at most. In Season 3 Chapter 4, she said goodbye to the Proxy in a dream as **Sleepwalkerboo**, showing them the paths her daughters might have taken and the women they became (see "S3 Ch4 · Sleepwalkers' Dialogue (The First Sunbringer's Farewell)"), and as her goodbye ended and she died, the Hive Lord Hollow broke loose and began swallowing Roscaelifer.

**As a person.** She loved people and she loved Bangboo, which she invented (her Lockspring line was meant to make them even better at protecting humanity; see "S2 · Lockspring's Origin"); when asked why Bangboo have such long ears, her answer is that they are just so adorable. Socially awkward, she was bad at naming things and worse at giving speeches. In Eldreda, she saw the same habit she had, carrying everything alone and using sacrifice to avoid the problems she wasn't willing to face. More than anything, she hoped her daughters would never have to carry their burdens alone.

APPEARANCE (the original, for flashback purposes): Tall and slow-moving, she was an organic, flesh-and-blood woman, unlike whatever the old Intelligent Construct facade claimed. Two segmented black horns rise from her crown and angle back over the head; in the older heraldic depictions they are drawn as curved horns tipped in gold. Her hair is white-silver and extraordinarily long, trailing past the knee, most of it worn loose with one section gathered high into a twisted tail. Her eyes are mismatched, the right a bright amber-gold and the left a pale ice-blue. She wears a heavy dark military cloak with a thick black fur ruff spiking out across both shoulders, over a high-collared black uniform with a blue tie. Tan bandolier straps cross the chest, and layered utility belts sit at the waist. A metal plate at her left breast carries a gold sun-blossom sigil. Her fingerless gloves are dark banded leather. In the archival portraits, she carries a standard, a long gold-shafted polearm flying an enormous banner that fades from deep blue through pale blue to white, with her hair streaming beside it in translucent sheets and her coat opening into layered black-and-blue panels chased with gold.

(Note for narration: the split divided this figure between the three of them, while the original person died after saying her final goodbye to the Proxy. Lindverne kept the horned crown and both eye colours, while Dracaene's visible eye is the gold one, the other permanently hidden behind her fringe. Eldreda kept the face and the hair, along with the horns and the bearing. Anyone who knew the original will notice this and find it unsettling. In the near past, her body stood in the Secret Chamber shackled in Porcelloy, so that it still read as a statue, holding the shrunken Hive Lord Hollow in her hands like an Ether core. In dreams, she appeared as Sleepwalkerboo, a Bangboo. Her original Ethereal shape from her years as a larva has never been shown, so keep it to shadow and suggestion in any flashback. In the present, she is now deceased, and her death led to Youkai and Truvia seizing the opportunity of the Hive Lord Hollow's rampant expansion to cause chaos in Roscaelifer.)

19.content:
### 🎴 SEASON 2 INTERLUDE (v2.6) · ENCORE FOR AN OLD DREAM

Phaethon returns to New Eridu by helping a budding virtual idol band called the **Angels of Delusion** finally spread their wings and take flight.

## 🎤 The Members of Angels of Delusion · Who They Are and How They Got Here

The unit is made up of three members and a manager, all of whom carry a specific personal history into the group.

20.content:
**Cecilia (Lady Cersea):** Cecilia was a famous singer and songwriter who worked under the name "Cersea", but she suffered PTSD following the Fall of the Old Capital, which made her unable to sing despite the numerous songs she wrote at the time. Her agency forced her to continue her work, as her singing could help alleviate the hopelessness felt by the people following the catastrophe. She signed on to be the Angels' vocal coach, though due to her lingering guilt over having Aria work as her voice double, she withheld her former identity as Cersea from the group. She also came to take over 404 Error, offering invitations to various groups such as Satellite, The Forecasters, The Darkforge and The Deepsea Aliens.

APPEARANCE: Tall, with sea-green hair in an enormous fall that reaches past her knees, its ends splitting into pale translucent fins and a few strands worked into thin braids. More of the same fins fan from both sides of her head, angular and glassy blue-green, and a chartreuse band crosses the crown. Her eyes are bright violet and usually half-lidded, with a small mark beneath one, and her smile is warm and well practiced. At her throat sits a black ruffled lace choker hung with a large pale cabochon ringed in gold beads, with a small feather charm beside it. She wears a lime-green cropped jacket off both shoulders, its full, gathered sleeves buttoned in gold at the cuffs, over a cream bodice panelled in teal at the chest and fastened with gold bow clasps. A brass ornamental belt hangs with tassels and coin plates among brown braids. Below that falls a long dark-teal skirt, slit high and cut through with wing-shaped gaps, its fabric scattered with white star-sparks. It is layered under a white ruffled drape that trails to the floor over pale platform sandals. Both forearms are wrapped to the knuckles in white bandaging.

21.content:
**Aria · The Type A-H0L0 Construct:** Unlike her bright, glamorous stage persona, Aria's true form is an A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct, built for combat. However, as she took part in more combat operations, she slowly grew to hate the feeling of "bringing pain to others". After being abandoned in a Hollow alongside others of the same model, she was awakened once more by Cersea's singing. In Eridu, she saw how such a voice could spark hope in people and draw them into "delusions", and it was then that the desire to sing began to take root within her. By chance, she once served as Cersea's "voice double", but after Cersea retired, she returned to normal life. It was only after Nangong and Sunna invited her to join the Angels of Delusion that Aria stepped onto a stage and met the Delulus who loved her voice face-to-face. Perhaps shaped by her past experiences, Aria feels deeply insecure about her identity as a Construct.

APPEARANCE: Aria has two bodies and can switch between them at will, even mid-sentence.

**Construct form (A-H0L0 chassis, her true shell):** A compact combat frame in white and rose-pink armour plating, the joints and underlayers matte black. The face is hidden behind a black wraparound visor with a scalloped upper edge, with twin teal optical lenses glowing through it and only her mouth left uncovered beneath. Two long pink plates rise from the head like rabbit ears, hinged and antenna-tipped. Her chest plate is a black core panel with a small orange sighting mark and a teal ribbon clipped to it; layered white skirt-plates flare at the hips over pink thigh segments and white shin armour. Small factory-stencilled model numbers sit on the plating.

**Idol holo-form (stage projection):** Bubblegum-pink hair in high twintails shot through with a mint-green streak, tied off with black-and-teal clips, bangs falling over one eye; the visible eye is a bright glassy blue. She wears a white idol dress with a gold lightning-bolt zip pull down the front and detached puffed sleeves cuffed in pink, under a stiff white feather-plate collar that spreads wide from her shoulders. The skirt is white ruffle layered over a round, vented teal-green panel with a cat-face decoration engraved into it. Pink ribbed socks with teal bows and white high-tops finish the look. Her default expression is a wink and a V-sign, a pose she strikes out of stage habit.

**Combat Style (Ether · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She is an Intelligent Construct who toggles between robot and idol holo-forms, delivering forward kicks and sonic-wave Specials that charge “Perfect Pitch” into Ether smashes and Abloom bursts. Render glitching bubblegum idol-light and concussive sound, butt stomps included.

22.content:
**Sunna · The Shy Genius Composer:** Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music. Sunna and Nangong Yu have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. One pivotal event came when Nangong Yu literally dragged Sunna out the door to sign the contract formalizing their entry into the Angels of Delusion. That contract marked the group's formation and propelled the shy composer from behind-the-scenes work into the spotlight as a performing idol.

APPEARANCE: She is small and round-faced with a childlike look, and she always seems a step behind the conversation. Her hair is pale blond-green, most of it bundled into one high side ponytail with a teal bow while the rest hangs loose, and the fringe is pinned back with a mismatched scatter of clips, from a pink bandage-shaped one and a small black cross to an abstract bunny with heart-eyes and a heart-shaped clip. Her eyes are wide and green, shading to orange at the outer edge. She wears a half-untucked white short-sleeved school shirt with a loose red necktie printed with small stars, and a black choker sits at her throat; a big teal polka-dot bow at her waist has a handheld pet-console clipped into it, screen out. Below that is a full, layered black tulle skirt. Everything on her limbs is mismatched. Her striped arm-sleeves, one pink and one purple, cover her hands with the fingers cut free. On her left leg, pink and purple striped leg-warmers sit over white platform shoes, while the right leg is striped pink and white. A single torn white thigh-high covers the leg with the pink garter strap and its little pouch. A pink satchel with one white wing rides on her back. She hauls around a megaphone-shaped emitter with a mint bow tied to the barrel.

**Combat Style (Physical · Support, S-Rank):** She is a shy, stage-fright crybaby idol-composer who fights alongside her pet Bubblegum, and between their co-attacks, she applies "Cat's Gaze" and grants an Ether Veil ATK buff. Render bouncy hammer-blows and clingy pet support.

23.content:
**Nangong Yu · The Captain Who Borrowed a Dream:** Nangong Yu's "talent" lets her glide through almost anything with ease, though for a long time, it also kept her from knowing what she herself felt. She's skilled at evaluating and planning for everything, yet when it comes to the seemingly intangible concept of "dreams", she can't put a price on it. When the Angels of Delusion formed, Nangong found herself dealing with a stingy agency that even charged its trainees for training. For the first time, she felt that her talent for "always spotting a business opportunity" had failed her. She could calculate the optimal choreography and predict which stocks would rise, yet she couldn't figure out how to keep this fragile group, built around Sunna's dream, alive. When their last savings ran dry and their only lead vocalist was about to quit under financial pressure, a dangerous "opportunity" appeared: use their unregistered Ether aptitude to enter a Hollow and carry out a high-paying "material recovery" job. In the end, they were lucky enough to complete the commission and bring back payment that could keep the group afloat. When they stumbled back into the safe zone and looked at the dust-covered reward in their hands, Nangong felt oddly flat. She realized that what she would risk her life and endure fear for were Sunna's melodies from that shabby rehearsal room and the songs Aria had sung, along with the voices and the stage that would one day belong to them. She wanted that more than any return on an investment. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed", she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Her affectionate nickname is Xiao'Yu.

APPEARANCE: A sharp black bob with a blunt fringe, cut level with her jaw, and two short tails bound in red at the sides; a large crimson silk blossom sits above one ear. Her eyes are a hard bright red and her mouth stays in a small managerial smile. A spiky, glossy teal halo hovers above her head and follows its movement. She wears a cropped ribbed top in white with wide bell cuffs, black fur trimming the shoulders and sleeve ends, over a rose-pink polka-dot bustier laced at the front; a white beast-skull mask is strapped flat against her right shoulder with a mint bow under it, worn purely as ornament. Her skirt is layered pink ruffle hemmed in black zigzag, with diamond-shaped cut-outs showing the skin of her thighs, and beneath it, she wears black tights with a red band high on one thigh. Bandage wrapping runs over both ankles into black platform heels. Her weapon is a mace with a long steel haft capped at both ends with heavy black spiked spheres checked in gold, each spike set with four teal cat's-eye stones. She holds a V-sign at her cheek while carrying it one-handed.

**Combat Style (Ether · Stun, S-Rank):** As the idol troupe's lead dancer and captain, she builds Daze amid flashy holographic stage effects, converting Anomaly Mastery into Impact. Render dance-fighting inside a projected light show.

24.content:
### ⚠️ Youkai · The Fourth Key

Before the Angels of Delusion arc can unfold in peace, it is necessary to understand what Youkai is. Youkai is a sophisticated AI and one of the four "keys" from outside New Eridu, together with Fairy, Jinni, and Ghost. It first appeared at the end of Season 2 Chapter 6 and is the major antagonist in Season 2 Interlude: Encore for an Old Dream. Together with the other three "keys", Youkai was planted by two unknown individuals from outside New Eridu inside the Inter-Knot Deep Database, with the mission to wait for someone who can awaken them. Their two old masters are monitoring their activation status from outside New Eridu. It swayed Lockspring to become a follower of the Creator and helped him bring about the advent of the Creator's Messenger, which was formed from Miasma and Sarah's body with Sunbringer's powers. After Lockspring's death, Youkai slipped loose from the destroyed vessel and made its way to New Eridu.

In Season 3, Youkai wore a counterfeit body in the likeness of the adult Serpico Mosseint and called himself Truvia's big brother (she can't stand it). He used Roscaelifer's Bangboo to open the Singularity Leakages and fed Mosseint the idea of controlling the Rosetta Data and commanding Roscaelifer, while his repeated intrusions wrecked Carinus (see "NPC BG · Serpico Mosseint (the deceased child & the adult impostor)" and "S3 Ch3 · Kusarikku, the Replacement Sunbringer (Serpico Is Youkai)"). With Truvia, he killed Mosseint. When Carinus tried to negotiate, Youkai claimed Mosseint was stuck in traffic and introduced Truvia as the High Ambitions heiress who spoke with his weight. After mocking Carinus' terms, he invited "the late Mr. Mosseint" to weigh in and showed Carinus the corpse (see "NPC BG · Mosseint (High Ambitions Corp., deceased)"). He calls Truvia a thing still playing dress-up as a person, and when she lay half-awake in a medical capsule and took him for her brother, he played Serpico's part for her. He mentioned Jinni as "our best at blending in", the most discreet of the four keys. At the end of Season 3 Chapter 4, he came for the Secret Chamber with Truvia and Bashmu as the Hive Lord Hollow broke loose, to retrieve in person what he had left behind there.

25.comment: S2 Interlude · The Dress Rehearsal Crisis
25.content:
### 🎭 The Dress Rehearsal Crisis · Youkai Takes Aria

The story of v2.6 begins with Phaethon accompanying Jane Doe to the 404 Error Livehouse, where the Angels of Delusion are holding a **dress rehearsal** for their upcoming Gilded Carrot Day debut. The siblings, along with Jane, head to the 404 Error Livehouse to watch the Angels of Delusion's rehearsal and happen to run into Vesper, who arrived as scheduled. For some reason, Jane appears slightly on guard.

After the first run-through, Vesper gave her feedback on the performance, while Cecilia hesitated to share her opinion, which frustrated Aria and led to a breakdown. Aria reaches out to the ever-reliable Wishing Sprite for answers, but it provides worse responses than usual, which make Aria lose control. This is the crack that Youkai has been waiting for. Youkai attacked Aria as a way to harm Fairy, who deeply cares for the Construct she once guided in battle.

With Youkai seizing control of Aria's systems mid-rehearsal, her bandmates face the worst possible scenario: their lead vocalist has become a threat to everyone in the building. Nangong Yu explains: "Aria fought hard against that Youkai's control just now. She chose to go dormant rather than let it hurt us. I think she just needs a little help right now. The Manager's smart assistant can definitely handle it." Sunna declares: "Alright, I trust Aria too!!!" Nangong Yu: "Yeah, she'll come back to us. The Angels of Delusion will be whole again." The team helps Aria escape the virtual stage and defeats the enemy, with Jane and Sunna fighting at Aria's side. Aria says: "If it weren't for you, I might have hurt Sunna and the others." Jane replies: "No trouble at all. Just doing my job~ Besides, Aria, you're way stronger than what you just showed. I should be thanking you for snapping out of it in time, and for going easy on me."

The truth about Cecilia being Lady Cersea is revealed to the full group at Gravity Cinema in Lumina Square, and at first, the revelation devastates Aria, who had idolised Cersea without knowing her manager was the same person. After she recovered, the master-student-pair came clean to one another, reconciling before continuing their preparations for their Gilded Carrot Day performance.

26.content:
### 🎙️ Lady Vesper · Youkai's Second Target

With Aria freed, Youkai immediately pivots to a new vessel. Youkai had managed to coerce Vesper, hoping to use her to disrupt the celebrations. Lurking in the shadows, it "corrupted" Vesper's emotions, scheming to pull off its "Special Program" and sabotage the Yearlight Ceremony to shock New Eridu. Vesper's short antagonistic streak was mostly fuelled by Youkai and TOPS.

Vesper, a singer and Intelligent Construct employed by TOPS Entertainment, travels to Failume Heights, where she draws Aria into a virtual confrontation. A cutscene unfolds as Aria and Vesper discuss their freedom as Intelligent Constructs. Suddenly, Vesper makes contact with Aria in the virtual space. The team helps Aria escape the virtual stage and defeat the enemy, with Jane and Sunna fighting at Aria's side.

After the fight, the jurisdictional conflict over Vesper begins. Zhu Yuan is sent to arrest Vesper over the latter's collaboration with Youkai, but she finds herself clashing with Zhao who wanted to research how and why Youkai was even able to corrupt Vesper at all. Neither the Public Security officer nor the Krampus judge would budge until (presumably) Commissioner Lowell orders Zhu Yuan to let Zhao take the suspect first, so long as Zhao returns the suspect to Public Security. Zhao explains: "Since the person involved is a TOPS employee, I was assigned to handle it." Zhao later reveals that she had one of her colleagues, Promeia, on standby in case her disagreement with Zhu Yuan escalated. Through this, the Proxy is able to meet Promeia for the first time. One of Zhao's co-workers, Promeia, made a brief appearance and seemed cold and distant towards others.

Vesper is thus taken into TOPS/Krampus custody for investigation into how Youkai was able to penetrate her Emotional Core, with the Forbidden Fruit compliance test waiting for her as part of the standard construct accountability procedure. Hopefully, Vesper is not stuck in the literal jail for too long.

APPEARANCE: She is an Intelligent Construct built for the stage and styled after a shrine effigy. Her face is a smooth chartreuse mask with black bands across the eyes and white ear-shapes lined in black over the brow. A small black logo marks the centre of the forehead above two painted pink ovals on the cheeks, and her optics glow yellow-green through it. Large gold hoops hang at both ears. Two enormous brass arcs sweep up from either side of her head and meet behind her in a wide standing loop, like a torii gate carried on her shoulders; from it fall long golden-tan drapes patterned with black motifs, reaching down to her arms. A vertical level meter of graded orange-to-green light segments runs down her sternum. Her torso is black armour over dark mesh, plated in gold at the collar and chest and again at the waist. Her arms end in gloved white hands. Her thighs are broad white-and-red plates set with narrow red lamps, and her lower legs are lacquer-red scrolled with gold filigree, tapering to points that serve as her feet.

27.comment: S2 Interlude · The Gilded Carrot Day Finale
27.content:
### 🌟 The Gilded Carrot Day Finale

With the Vesper situation handed over to Public Security and Krampus, the Angels of Delusion must decide their own path forward. After Aria overcame Vesper, Cecilia was asked to take the stage for the Yearlight Ceremony. She proposed to the Angels that they join her on stage, but they refused, not wanting to compromise their debut performance at the 404 Error Livehouse. Expressing her pride in them, the angels returned to Sixth Street, while Cecilia took the stage to perform at Failume Heights, singing the same song as the angels as they welcomed the new year.

Aria publicly performs at 404 Error Livehouse in her **true mechanical form** with the hologram switched off, and the crowd of Delulus loves her anyway. The Angels of Delusion are formally "spreading their wings", with Cecilia, Sunna, Nangong Yu and Aria bonded as family.

Meanwhile, Youkai, foiled but still intact, got in touch with a new partner: the head of High Ambitions Corp., known only as the "Lead Scepter". The malicious AI is still at large and scheming with its new partner.

28.content:
### 🎴 SEASON 2 EPILOGUE A (v2.7) · NEW ERIDAN SUNSET (A): THE CHAMPION

## 🏆 The Flint Porcelloy Cup

The headline event of the "New Eridan Sunset" festivities is **Hollow Championship**, a city-wide Hollow combat tournament. This year's Grand Prize is unprecedented: a custom-forged W-Engine made of **pure Flint Porcelloy**. The tournament is sponsored by Rusty Cliff Corp, with one billion Dennies and a rare Porcelloy W-Engine on the line.

**Flint Porcelloy** is a novel alloy of **Porcelume** (refined Lumite Ore) and several proprietary metals, developed under Marcel Group's legacy research lines. Its defining property is **Ether stabilisation**, meaning it damps out erratic Ether pulses. This matters enormously to Phaethon: Belle's and Wise's Ether-linked eye implants have been growing more painful and erratic ever since the Waifei arc. The main goal of the Phaethon Siblings was the Flint Porcelloy W-Engine "Concealed Light", which would help alleviate the effects of their malfunctioning ocular implants.

**The Marcel Group envoys.** Two new faces arrive to explain all of this to Phaethon: **Norma Hollowell** and **Velina Airgid**, both operatives of Marcel Group's **External Strategy Department**. They present the metallurgy and clinical data on Ether stabilisation, and the moment they realise the tournament's Grand Prize is made of the exact substance, they immediately sign up as participants and recruit Billy Kid and Nicole Demara of the Cunning Hares to round out the squad. In the last part of the story, Velina and Norma were also aiming to stop Remielle before she returns to Roscaelifer.

**Cissia as "Nicole."** On the morning of the competition, Nicole wakes up with a brutal upset stomach and physically cannot participate. That is the exact moment **Cissia** turns up uninvited in Belle's bedroom, a serpentine Thiren who works as a Public Security case specialist and never passes up a free meal or an easy opening. She agrees to step in and impersonate Nicole so the organisers don't notice the swap.

29.comment: S2 Epilogue A · Remielle's First Appearance
29.content:
**Remielle's first appearance.** Ramiel is a pink-haired angel Thiren that showed up during the Hollow Champion Event. She was wearing a mask that concealed half her face. Throughout the competition, she made use of her powers to clear through Ethereals with ease. Phaethon left Random Play to get some air, running into Ramiel in front of Godfinger, Asha’s arcade. She asked about them, down to their favorite Foodie Fighters character, and wanted help fixing their Ethereal card, which Phaethon gave despite not originally intending to. She explained that she now intended to go after the Porcelloy W-Engine, before cryptically saying she would "pay you back for this favor by dealing with your nightmare in the future."

**Sabotage in the ring.** Mid-tournament, someone injects malicious **Carrot data** into the participants' **Ethereal Cards**. Dozens of competitors are redirected into dead zones. In the middle of the chaos, **"Black Wolf" Romeul**, a hulking wolf Thiren whose horror-movie look is openly cribbed from Jason Voorhees of *Friday the 13th*, goes berserk and begins killing contestants. The organisers suspend the tournament. New Eridu Public Security and the Krampus Compliance Authority descend on the venue.

**Remielle steals the prize**
When Romeul stole the W-Engine alongside the rest of the prize pool, Ramiel pursued him into the Hollow. It was Ramiel's power that caused the faded Ethereals along the way. She unleashes her feathers on Phaethon's group, Cissia, Billy, Lucy and Lighter among them, to temporarily stop time and obtain the Flint Porcelloy from their grasp.

30.comment: S2 Epilogue A · The Sweepers Revealed
30.content:
**The Sweepers revealed.** Romeul and Promeia were once comrades in an Outer Ring gang called the **Sweepers**, a ruthless "cleanup" crew whose role was to finish off the bloodwork and loose ends left behind by the **original Calydons**. Cissia originally hails from the Outer Ring, and growing up under the regime of the Calydon gang, she experienced severe poverty, resorting to theft and scavenging. A particular survival tactic of hers was to stake out places the Sweepers were rumored to target and wait for them to finish "cleaning up" before sneaking in to grab whatever she could. At one point, she ran into trouble with a pair of scavengers who beat her to secure any valuables for themselves. Promeia arrived in the aftermath, brutally killing the pair, with a terrified Cissia fleeing for her life, the incident causing her to develop a deep fear of Promeia.

**Promeia vs. Cissia**: Promeia knocks out Cissia before confronting the Proxy towards the end of "New: Eridan Sunset (A)," but Cissia gets back up and stands her ground anyway. Promeia admits she did not expect Cissia to behave so courageously.

**Mors's regrouping**: Mors, the former Vanquishers teammate of Pulchra Fellini, was the third party who fed the bad Carrot data into the Ethereal Cards and coordinated with Romeul. With Lucius gone and the Vanquishers dissolved, Mors threw in with the Sweepers.

**Aftermath**: After the incident was cleaned up by Public Security, Cissia revealed to Phaethon that all of Ramiel's details were fabricated, and that "Ramiel" didn't seem to exist at all. Elsewhere, Velina Airgid and Norma Hollowell resolved to find Ramiel before she returned to Roscaelifer.

31.comment: S2 Epilogue A · The Golden Ether Nightmare
31.content: **Belle's (or Wise's) nightmare.** After the tournament, Belle (or Wise) experiences a vivid and disturbing dream-sequence in which their hands are coated in a strange golden Ether-like substance. Through the gold, they see fragments of the Fall of the Old Capital and the crest of **Helios Academy** shattering. They wake up gasping.

32.comment: S2 Epilogue B · The Truth Beneath the Feather (v2.8)
32.content:
### 🎴 SEASON 2 EPILOGUE B (v2.8) · NEW ERIDAN SUNSET (B): THE TRUTH BENEATH THE FEATHER

The Proxies team up with Promeia and Cissia, plus the upgraded Starlight Billy, to investigate the mysterious Remielle, a target pursued by multiple factions. The story delves into Remielle's true identity and motives and the secrets of the Krampus Compliance Authority, while hinting at betrayal within TOPS and at the next major destination, Roscaelifer.

## 🤝 The Unlikely Alliance

Promeia forms a temporary alliance with the Proxies and Cissia, joined by the upgraded Starlight Billy, to uncover Ramiel's true identity and intentions. The alliance is uneasy from the start. Due to their uneasy shared past, Cissia is obviously afraid of the ex-Sweeper. However, Zhao states that she's not quite what she thinks. Zhao keeps her on a tight leash; Promeia's "murder is the best solution" tendencies nearly had her pick a fight with Public Security and harm Phaethon, someone protected by two Void Hunters, a reckless decision that required Krampus to have her back off and apologize. Her role here is officially intelligence work, gathering data on Remielle for TOPS and Krampus simultaneously.

33.content:
### 🔴 Billy Kid Becomes Starlight Billy

Starlight Billy is a significantly upgraded version of Billy, featuring his new fit as a Starlight Knight that includes the red scarf from his time as The Champion of the Sons of Calydon. His new equipment can turn into guns and cannons, and it can even whip out a motorcycle. The financial logistics of this upgrade are a source of considerable stress for Nicole, who notes that Billy had been asking for an advance on his income to buy some big-ticket item. Billy characteristically frames the advance as something Nicole fully endorsed. Nicole characteristically frames it as something that happened to her bank account without her informed consent.

34.comment: S2 Epilogue B · Back to the Outer Ring & Promeia's Side
34.content:
## 🏍️ Back to the Outer Ring

The investigation sends Cissia and Billy back into the Outer Ring's familiar streets. Remielle's path is confirmed to have passed through Lucy de Montefio and Lighter's territory, with the Sons of Calydon's network already mobilized. The reunion is part work and part personal for Cissia and Billy, who are moving through the terrain where both grew up on very different terms from their last time there.

## 🕊️ Promeia's Side of the Story

The alliance forces Promeia and Cissia into the same operational space, and the truth of their first encounter finally surfaces. What Cissia never knew, and what Promeia now clarifies, is that her targets that day were the two adult scavengers, not the small serpentine girl hiding in the debris. Promeia's intent, after finishing her actual targets, was simply to reach out toward the frightened child. Coming from a Sweeper with blood on her hands, this registered to Cissia's survival instincts as a lethal threat. Cissia ran while Promeia let her go. For years, Cissia developed a deep, instinctual fear of Promeia based on a complete misreading of that moment. The correction lands hard: Promeia was feared as a ruthless assassin and racked up quite the kill count back when she was with the Sweepers, but the specific incident that scarred Cissia was never what she thought it was.

35.comment: S2 Epilogue B · The Proxy Snaps (Ethereal)
35.content:
## ⚡ The Proxy Snaps · Belle (or Wise) Becomes an Ethereal

The crisis that forces Remielle's hand arrives not from the investigation but from within the Proxy themselves. The golden Ether corruption, the same substance glimpsed in the dream fragments of Helios Academy, floods the Proxy's visual cortex and begins converting them. Phaethon mutates from the cavity into the form of "remnants of the sun" and fights the party. Just as Remielle is about to finish off the party, Phaethon is stopped and brought back from their corrosive state, which turns their clothes and wings white.

It falls to **Billy** and **Cissia**, with **Promeia** beside them, to fight the corrupted Proxy, the very person they have been protecting, and hold them at bay without killing them. Billy's upgraded Starlight frame was built for high-damage, high-endurance fights like this one, and it is what makes containment possible. Promeia's capabilities suppress the Ether surge from outside. Cissia, with her electric attack kit and serpentine speed, keeps the fight mobile enough that the corrupted Proxy can't lock onto a single target.

Remielle arrives and uses her feather-power to halt the Ether activity surging through the Proxy, bringing them back from the edge. The corruption reverses and the golden Ether recedes. She sincerely apologises to the protagonist, saying she regrets always being late, and tells them there is a doctor in Roscaelifer who can treat them. She explained she has a connection to Helios, like them, and that a doctor in Roscaelifer would be able to heal their condition before putting them to sleep. Her whereabouts afterwards are unknown.

36.comment: S2 Epilogue B · Promeia's Warning Note
36.content:
## 📝 Promeia's Warning Note

After resting, the Proxy heads downstairs to talk with Billy and Cissia, who are waiting. Promeia has left a note warning the team not to trust TOPS or Krampus, or even her. The note is blunt and cold, and it is more honest than almost anything Promeia has said out loud during the entire arc. Whatever she witnessed during the investigation and whatever she knows about TOPS' intentions regarding Roscaelifer has crossed a line she will not cross for her employers. She warns the Proxies without formally betraying Krampus, and disappears.

37.comment: S2 Epilogue B · Krampus Travels to Roscaelifer
37.content:
### 🎪 Zhao and Promeia · Krampus Travels to Roscaelifer

A cutscene plays as Promeia returns to the Krampus Compliance Authority quarters to report back. They will be traveling to Roscaelifer with Phoenix to further investigate the situation for TOPS. This confirms that Zhao, as Krampus's operational head, has escalated. The fact that they are sending **Phoenix**, one of Krampus's most formidable assets, alongside Promeia suggests stakes far higher than routine intelligence gathering. TOPS has a stake in Roscaelifer, likely tied to the post-Ferox, post-Lucro power vacuum over Porcelume supply chains and the Lemnian Hollow research, and Krampus is going in force to maintain order within the association.

38.comment: S2 Epilogue B · Velina & Norma Reveal Everything
38.content:
## 🌅 Velina and Norma Reveal Everything

Velina and Norma formally reintroduce themselves, revealing that they are from Roscaelifer's External Strategy Department and will guide the Proxies there while they receive their treatment. Velina mentioned that the Proxies need to be cautious of Remielle as well, as she is a wanted criminal for her attempted assassination of the High Consul of Roscaelifer, Lady Sunbringer. Their whole stay in New Eridu followed a plan, from the Flint Porcelloy introduction at the tournament and their obsession with tracking Remielle up to this formal reveal. The tournament was a thinly veiled excuse to intercept Remielle before she returned to Roscaelifer and to make contact with the Phaethon siblings. Pyrois is connected to the power hidden within Phaethon's eyes and embodies the legacy of Helios Academy. With this new figure, more about the siblings' history and the significant events that took place during their time at Helios Academy may finally come to light.

As the Proxy receives the news, it's time to go upstairs and discuss the travel plans with their sibling. They will both be traveling to Roscaelifer.

39.comment: End of Season 2 · State of the World
39.content:
## 🧩 END OF SEASON 2 · THE STATE OF THE WORLD BEFORE SEASON 3

- **The Exaltists** are dead as an organization. Sarah Floren died in the ritual. The Creator's sub-manifestation was slain by Ye Shunguang. The **true Creator** is still at large.
- **Youkai** is still out there. After being expelled from Aria's Logic Core and foiled at the Yearlight Ceremony, it has partnered with **Lead Scepter**, the head of High Ambitions Corp. 40.content:
## SEASON 3

# ☀️ CHAPTER 1 · A SLEEPWALKER'S CONFESSION 🌙

The day finally arrives, and none other than Norma takes Phaethon to Roscaelifer on an airship, with Cissia and Starlight Billy along for the ride. When they arrive, Norma does a tour of the city to them, while Velina shows them their rooms in Amber Hall. She also gave them their Aurelia Academy uniforms because they got transported there under the guise of being exchange students to this educational branch of the ESD (as such, Amber Hall functions as the student residency of the academy). Aurelia Academy offers standard courses alongside classes on instructing Bangboo and Ether-related studies. It also teaches people how to regulate certain physical conditions. This gives the Proxies a deeper understanding of Roscaelifer and access to professional medical care at the same time. Cissia is registered in the databases as an emotional support pet by Norma, while Billy is administered as a "high-performance, multifunctional domestic support unit", aka. a household appliance.

After falling asleep, Belle (or Wise) experiences a nightmare involving their days at Helios Academy when they were just kids. Two of their classmates, Truvia Mosseint and Serpico, are present in the dream who tell the past versions of Belle and Wise that there is a test involving the new eye implants that were calibrated on that day. The young Phaethon tell them that if they go there, something terrible is going to happen to them, based on their gut feelings. This is when the sweet memory turns into a painful nightmare, where the Ethereal inside Belle and Wise starts blaming them for the death of Serpico and Truvia distancing herself from them after the (accidental) murder.

After this, the nightmare is suddenly cut short by a big explosion, because an experiment on Logic Cores that Norma was conducting went wrong and left her stuck inside her own lab. This draws the attention of the deputy director of Roscaelifer's police force, the Airspace Patrol, Sigrid de L'Azur; a blonde low-scale horse Thiren. Sigrid warns Norma that she should stop experimenting with Logic Cores for a while because when eight Bangboo got deployed into Scamall Hollow (the Hollow directly under the floating islands of Roscaelifer) due to unstable and unpredictable Ether activity, all of their new Logic Cores got corrupted beyond repair, killing the Bangboo almost instantly. When Velina arrives, she takes full responsibility for not keeping an eye on her colleague, which cools the tension between Norma (the head technician of the External Strategy Department and Chief Technical Officer of Marcel Group) and Sigrid (the Deputy Director of Airspace Patrol).

Before going back to bed after the nighttime incident, the Proxy gets to chat with Norma a bit, where it gets revealed that the ESD is also responsible for the retirement of Bangboo, where due to the limitations in the design of their memory modules, all of their memories have to get wiped, since everything they have seen in Roscaelifer is highly classified, top-secret information. This makes them hated among the Bangboo citizens of the floating city, since a full memory wipe is like death to the cute rabbit-like robots. (The ones handling Rosetta Data (a compilation of all the world's navigation [Carrot] data's master copy) at the Central Computing Department [CCD] wear out faster, so they have to go into retirement and lose their most precious memories faster.)

This is when the goal of the mission becomes clear: we have to clear Norma's name and prove that she didn't mean to tamper with the Bangboo Logic Cores in a way to intentionally hurt the Bangboo. After all, they represent more than 60% of the city's population.

The next day, Norma comes to fetch the Proxies along with Cissia and Billy, still very energetic despite having barely slept during the night. She is there to bring Belle and Wise into the CCD and begin their treatment, since they basically have a miniature Hollow inside their bodies. This is when we get to know that Flint Workshop (one of the five important factions in Roscaelifer) was the one that created Flint Porcelloy and they are still, to this day, the only ones who can make this metal alloy. This alloy is very important, as it makes up the core structural framework of the islands. Void Hunter weapons like Tailless and the Qingming Sword were mainly made out of it, and so was Thaumiel.

On their way there, they encounter the legendary Lady Sunbringer herself, serious and confident, with a posture and gait that intimidate. Because of the recent incident with the 8 dead Bangboo, she is announcing to a large crowd a strategic cooperation between Roscaelifer and New Eridu, based on the decision of the five Central Departments (Administrative Affairs Department, Central Computing Department, Airspace Patrol Department, Flint Workshop and External Strategy Department), in hopes of better protecting the world from harm. The policy allows outsiders to enter Roscaelifer for the first time in a long time, and it is also what got the Phaethon duo and their two friends, Billy and Cissia, onto the main floating island of Booastrum.

Right at the gate, Norma tells Belle and Wise a little secret: Roscaelifer supplied Helios Academy with Porcelloy and helped them do medical treatments. This makes Phaethon come to the conclusion that Lady Sunbringer might have known Carole Arna personally.

41.comment: S3 Ch1 · One Into Three (The Split Sunbringer)
41.content:
# ONE INTO THREE · THE TALE OF THE SPLIT SUNBRINGER

Entering the CCD building, the Proxies and their friends get to see the biggest twist in their lives so far. A child walks up to them, with the intent of analysing her patient. She is also introduced as Lady Sunbringer, which confuses the ever-living hell out of everyone, especially Cissia, making her tell funny quips. This is when Velina tells everyone that Norma omitted a crucial information about Lady Sunbringer to them and the child tells that the Sunbringer on the balcony from before and her are not the same person (but somehow, they technically still are at the same time to some extent).

The mysterious child Sunbringer: "Hee-hee, looks like you've mistaken me and Eldreda for the same person."

This is when the kid Sunbringer introduces herself as Dracaene Sunbringer and tells the names of the other two Sunbringers: Lindverne and Eldreda Sunbringer. The three Sunbringers are different manifestations of the original Lady Sunbringer who used to be one person; different pockets of her personality that split into autonomous people of their own a long, long time ago. This is when we get to know that the original Lady Sunbringer was an Intelligent Construct (aka. a humanoid robot just like Qingyi, Banyue or Aria). Apparently, splitting into three people is more efficient at protecting the islands of Roscaelifer for a century now and distributes political, research, logistics and military load evenly.

The three Sunbringers have received three pieces of the original Lady Sunbringer's Karma Cores to guard them, which drove the splitting process forward. They didn't inherit all the memories of the original Lady Sunbringer, as some memories got lost to time with the 3 of them. Out of all of them, Eldreda knows the most about the original; she also resembles the original Sunbringer the most, looking near-identical to the original. Eldreda is extremely busy most of the time (much like Yixuan Shifu), since she leads Roscaelifer's Administrative Affairs Department (the AAD), the governing political and defense force of the islands. As its head, she creates the rules and handles policies, and she is the one who makes decisions and coordinates the other departments. Her stern, serious manner makes her look tough, but in reality, Eldreda is fair and lenient towards others. More came out of Dracaene as a Freudian slip, since she couldn't stop singing the praises of her other self: Eldreda is very sociable and a real talker, and she is into music and plays the acoustic guitar well.

Dracaene is the head of the Central Computing Department, the computing centre responsible for calculating Rosetta Data and the main coordinator behind the medical recovery of the Phaethon siblings. She is talented at technical affairs, being the part of the original Lady Sunbringer that created all the Bangboo of the world, but is not a good explainer.

Lindverne Sunbringer, however, is the Director of Roscaelifer's Airspace Patrol Department (the APD), the islands' police force, responsible for managing internal affairs and keeping the internal peace of the islands. (She visited Vyrium Island to get her equipment calibrated at Flint Workshop and bring Claret to the arranged tea party Velina organised.) She's chill and laid-back. Being treated like someone's boss and authority figure is something she hates, and she doesn't like strict protocols that squeeze her into a tight role either. She has a similar energy to Billy Kid, always approachable and free-spirited, and she even shares Billy's obsession with Starlight Knight. To those she knows, she is a reliable and trustworthy friend. Characterise her in a way very similar to Billy Kid.

Flint Workshop and the External Strategy Department serve as supporting cast to the core 3 departments from above and are supervised jointly by all three Lady Sunbringers.

Flint Workshop is the main driving force behind Porcelloy tech and products based around Porcelloy and is the Research and Development wing of the city council. Its leader is Claret Flint, Director of Flint Workshop. Claret is very narcissistic and earnest, being very upfront (and even brash) about her opinions on people. Much like anyone with narcissistic personality disorder, she can only be handled by complimenting her and sucking up to her all the time to stroke her fragile ego.

Finally, the ESD connects Roscaelifer with New Eridu and providing technical support for Bangboo. Its leader is Velina Airgid.

(Later chapters overturn the Intelligent Construct claim above. The first Sunbringer was the Enchainer of the Hive Lord Hollow living as a human, and the three sisters are flesh-and-blood Enchainers she made from her own Karma Core; see "S3 Ch3 · The Storm Has Yet to Settle (Sunbringer's Secret)" and "S3 Ch4 · Who Is Trapped in the Secret Room (The Secret Chamber)".)

42.content:
# TAMING THE BEAST · FROM CRUEL ETHEREAL MONSTER TO THE REFINED PYROIS

After getting a refresher on who the Sunbringers are and the power structures of Roscaelifer, Belle (or Wise) gets into a special Porcelloy-coated pod to receive medication, while their sibling, Cissia, Billy and Dracaene are watching them from the control panel.

There, the Proxy getting the treatments falls unconscious for a while, and in that deep coma, Belle (or Wise) has to face the ugliest parts of their past. After they got the eye implant, the Ethereal that came with it went berserk, and they accidentally got one of their classmates, Serpico, killed. They also have to relive seeing Truvia distance herself from them because of it. Both the guilt and the Ethereal inside are trying to consume them.

Eventually, Phaethon's immense willpower wins out, and they tame the Ethereal inside them into Pyrois: the force awakened in them to do incredible things. With it, they can finally fight in combat and even grind on rails Sonic the Hedgehog-style. When they wake, Dracaene explains the new relationship between them and Pyrois and gives them an **Ether Level Limiter**, a gun of her own invention made to keep an Etheric Other in check (it saves the day against Truvia in "S3 Ch4 · Pyrois Against the Blasphemer (Showdown with Truvia)"), and she laments that the treatment used far more Porcelloy than she expected and dreads what Claret will say.

After waking up, they test their shiny new combat skills in a training room with Billy until a power outage forces them to get out of the CCD building fast. Something went out of control under Roscaelifer's main island, Booastrum, and Phaethon and co. have to go there and investigate. The Energy Hub that went out is right next to Scamall Hollow (but not INSIDE of it), although the area has always been exposed to free-flowing Ether. In that moment, the Ether concentration has far exceeded safe levels and that had to get curbed. This is also where Norma was at during that day, testing the new Logic Cores, which made her even more suspicious to people and Bangboo alike. She got trapped in there, not being able to reach her out through comms.

The situation also gets more entangled, as Lady Dracaene can't go with them due to her assistant, Cora notifying her about the main computers of the CCD getting overloaded after switching the core computing division to Emergency Protocol 73, which would be a problem because that pile of data contains important navigation records.

Meanwhile, it turns out Sigrid and the APD are short on manpower and the Proxies and their friends join in to help their cause. Sigrid reluctantly agrees to the idea Velina brought to her from them, but with the condition of following Airspace Patrol's command. They technically shouldn't do this since the ESD and the APD are not allowed to act outside of their jurisdictions, but right now, extreme problems require extreme solutions. After all, they can't lose any more lives, including Bangboo lives.

Sigrid's plan is to split the squad into two: her squad goes into the area with the worst blackout to handle repairs and rescue operations, while Phaethon Squad goes to find Norma and civilians along the way. She also said to look out for damage the energy facilities, as well, shall they have enough bandwidth to do so.

She also notifies Velina and Belle (or Wise, depending on which Proxy you play as) about the presence of **Singularity Leakages** in the Energy Hub. Since the area is next to Scamall Hollow, the Ether concentration is very high, meaning the air is thick with Miasma, with free-floating Ether. When the concentration gets dangerously dense, the local space around starts getting distorted, creating a pocket dimension that is fused with part of Scamall Hollow; basically speaking, it creates a mini-Hollow. Just like in a Hollow, the laws of physics say a warm goodbye and things get awry fast.

After Sigrid goes away, Phaethon's team would take a railcar deeper into the Energy Hub, but the underside of it is cut off. Since the hub is closed, they aren't able to dispatch another one either. This is when Pyrois appears out of thin air from Belle (or Wise) and reluctantly agrees to help them. As such, Pyrois puts Belle (or Wise), Billy, Cissia, Eous (the Phaethon siblings' main Bangboo) and Velina into a pocket dimension inside the Ethereal Core on its chest and rail-grinds them to their destination.

APPEARANCE (original untamed form · flashbacks and pre-taming scenes only): Before Phaethon subdued it, the Ethereal was bare and unrestrained.
