She survived the Hollow Zero disaster as a small child: missing for 24 hours, she was found at the border of the Vulcan and Janus Quarters by a Hollow Investigation squad whose captain comforted her by teaching her a song, believing music brings solace, before he and most of his team died telling her to “live on with a smile”. That was the spark for her career. She controls a Bangboo named Snap using the same Bangboo-synchronization technology Phaethon uses with Eous, marking her unusual access to that tech. She is a major fan of a late singer's, Joran de Winter's discography, which in turn inspired her to also pursue the path of singing and music.

**Joran de Winter and the woman captain · two separate figures in Astra's past:** Accounts of Astra's origin often merge two different people into one, and canon keeps them apart. The person who found her after the fall of the Old Capital was the unnamed woman captain of a Hollow Investigation squad, who calmed the lost child by teaching her a song. When a single lift remained, she ordered that only the rope holding Astra be raised, and she died with her squad after telling Astra to live on with a smile. The person whose music set Astra on her path was Joran de Winter, though the two never met. Afterwards, huddled in a makeshift shelter and still terrified, she heard Joran's music playing from a distant speaker; it eased her fear and dried her tears, and seeing the other refugees around her moved by the same song made her decide to become the songstress of the new era. Her favourite line of his is "Every heart is a lonely note", which is why she describes her own ambition as weaving the staff lines that those notes can sit on.

APPEARANCE: Extremely long dark teal-black hair streams behind her, held back by a pale striped headband, framing bright magenta eyes and a broad performer's smile. A red ruffled tailcoat with a high collar and gold buttons, its cuffs banded in gold, slips off her shoulders, worn over a white-and-silver corseted bodice studded with gold stars and pearl trim. Below it sit layered white ruffled skirts gathered into large bows over a black underskirt, with a small white ring-shaped ornament floating at her hip. She wears gold hoop earrings and a pearl choker with a gold medallion, and a strand of pearls with a black ribbon is strapped around one bare thigh. Her feet are in black platform Mary Janes with bows and pearl ankle straps. She leans on a tall gold staff topped with a large golden ring that cradles a faceted grey gem behind a pale disc slotted into the disc player's tray mechanism and a microphone.

**Combat Style (Ether · Support, S-Rank):** She is a pop idol who channels Ether through her mic (Hemiola), granting Quick Assists, heals, ATK/CRIT-DMG buffs and extra Chain Attacks with almost no field time. Render shimmering songlight and stage-magic support.

168.comment: Agent BG · Evelyn Chevalier (Stars of Lyra)
168.content:
**Evelyn Chevalier · Stars of Lyra (background):** Astra Yao's manager and bodyguard, and a former professional spy/assassin from “The Organization”. She was hired by the rival label Fugue, under the spy codename “Scheele's Green”, to infiltrate Odeum HAE as Astra's bodyguard, a job begun about two years earlier. Time spent with Astra changed her; she defected and gave her loyalty entirely to protecting Astra, forming a motherly bond towards the up-and-coming singer. She guards a personal secret an enemy could exploit, and is the only person who has ever seen Astra without her makeup.

APPEARANCE: Her blonde hair is gathered into a short braided updo with a small plait wrapped at the side, above calm violet eyes and a black choker fitted with a gold bell. A long black coat lined in deep red, its tails edged with gold piping, is draped over her shoulders and held up by one hand. Beneath it, she wears a sleeveless white high-collared top clasped at the throat with gold, crossed by black harness straps over a black buttoned waistcoat. She also wears a golden tie. Her hands are gloved in red and black, with a plain band around her upper arm. Glossy black leather trousers are belted at the waist with a metal ring and strapped at one thigh, ending in pointed black high-heeled boots with gold soles. She holds a short curved knife.

**Combat Style (Fire · Attack, S-Rank):** As Astra's bodyguard, she lashes and binds foes with fiery bladed wires before snapping into invulnerable “Blazing Armor” for aggressive burst. Render whipping incandescent cords and tightening snares.

169.content:
**Hugo Vlad · Mockingbird leader:** The suave phantom-thief boss of Mockingbird and Lycaon's estranged former partner; full backstory is in the “Von Lycaon's Hidden History” entry.

APPEARANCE: Long blond hair falls loose past his shoulders with a lower section swept back, framing heterochromatic eyes, one pale green and one red, with a small red mark beneath the red one and a faint smile. He wears a deep navy buttoned shirt with a pale blue-white tie. A navy blazer with long swallowtails hangs over his shoulders, and an iridescent pale scarf trails to the floor. Gold and silver pocket watches hang on chains at his chest and belt, with a small gold bird pin at the lapel. He wears thin bracelets at both wrists and a dark navy glove on one hand. Black trousers are held by a braided belt with a metal ring, over polished black dress shoes. He carries a large dark armoured case in one hand and flips a two-toned gold-and-silver coin in the other.

**Combat Style (Ice · Attack, S-Rank):** He fights with an attaché case that transforms into a rifle (Final Notice), landing sleek, debonair ranged Ice shots that scale brutally against Stunned foes, and with a scythe that delivers quick, chilling cuts. Render gentleman-assassin marksmanship with frost-blue muzzle flashes, plus icy scythe work up close.

170.content:
Vivian Banshee's backstory: Vivian Banshee has always been despised by people who witness her predict other persons' deaths through her tears. Even though she uses her precognition for saving everyone, she failed every single time. She was formerly a member of the Exaltists alongside Dina, Camille, and Landon. Landon revealed his true self and pulled out a gun to kill everyone, to which Camille stepped in and killed Landon with his own pistol. Dina, upon witnessing her father's death, vowed to get revenge on Vivian, starting a lifelong feud between the former friends.

Vivian is an obsessive fan of Phaethon, often calling Belle and Wise "Lord Phaethon" and regularly simping for them with the dedication of an out-there fangirl for her K-pop idol.

APPEARANCE: Long pale lilac hair falls past her waist and curls into heavy ringlets at the ends, with a broad platinum-white streak running through the fringe and a single strand standing up at the crown. Her ears are elf-like (long and pointed), and her eyes are deep red, with a small mole beneath one of them. Her lips are usually parted as though she is about to say something. A black headpiece sits at the back of her hair with a purple bow at one side, and a pair of grey articulated struts rise from it. She wears a white dress with a high frilled collar striped in pale lilac, closed at the throat by a black ribbon set with a small blue-white gem, over a scalloped bodice fastened with tiny silver buttons; detached white shoulder pieces button over the upper arms and leave the shoulders bare. A wide, glossy black corset belt ribbed in the style of an obi cinches her waist, hung with a silver dagger-shaped ornament at the sternum and a second blade-tipped strap swinging from one hip on a thin cord. She holds her umbrella in her hand; the umbrella itself is panelled in black and lavender with a scalloped frilled edge, small bows around the rim and her name printed across several panels, tipped at the crown with a long silver spike and running down to a curved chrome handle finished like a blade. Below the bigger dagger-like ornament, a pleated white skirt printed with falling-teardrop motifs is layered under a dark indigo overskirt cut into sharp pointed petals and embroidered with pale filigree, with a large purple wing-like panel bearing a lavender teardrop crest hanging behind her. Her legs are in sheer black tights ending in black Mary Jane heels with buckle straps and small bows. Her nails are long and dark purple.

**Combat Style (Ether · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She wields a giant parasol (Flight of Ceremony) that bursts into Ether feather-blades, toggling Guard Feather (defensive) and Feather (offensive) stances to stack Corruption. Render a storm of drifting, slicing feathers.

171.content:
**Soldier 11 (Harin) · Obol Squad (background):** A frontline assault specialist whose codename hides the discarded real name “Harin”. She was a Silver Squad replica and “sister” to Soldier 0 (Anby). When command planned to dispose of all replicas but the best, Anby protected them. The night before a deadly mission, Harin was hurt, so Anby took her place, and on returning, she was ordered to kill Soldier 11. Anby instead slit her own throat so the Division would spare Harin. Not knowing the truth, Soldier 11 grew to resent the seemingly traitorous Anby and vowed to surpass her, becoming an exemplary soldier and Obol Squad's last member. Her arc and a kidnapping by the presumed-dead “sister” Twiggy (foiled by Trigger and Anby) push the Silver Squad mystery forward. During the Twiggy incident, she lost all of her memories, but Trigger and Anby helped her recover them slowly.

APPEARANCE: Her silvery-white hair is cut to the jaw, with a short spiky ponytail tied off with a red band. Visor goggles with a yellow lens sit above amber-gold eyes, and her mouth is slightly open. She wears slim translucent white sleeves ending in black gloves on both of her arms and a bulky grey-and-gold mechanical frame is mounted over her left shoulder and back. She wears a long grey sleeveless coat-dress over a black and yellow harnessed top with a yellow scarf at her neck, buckled chest straps, a red zip pull, and a row of yellow ammunition pouches on her belt. Black leggings run into armoured knee plates, one shin banded in orange and black, ending in heavy gold-and-black boots. She holds a dark katana-style blade with a bright silver edge low at her side.

**Combat Style (Fire · Attack, S-Rank):** She fights with crisp military swordsmanship, igniting her longsword for heavy fiery slashes. Render drilled, economical cuts wreathed in flame.

172.content:
**Trigger (Phlegethon) · Obol Squad sniper (background):** Once a shy soldier named Phlegethon, recruited into the Defense Force's Lyre Squad by captain Charon, who renamed her “Trigger” and gave the name Phlegethon to her rifle. Lyre Squad treated her like their kid; they fell during the Fall of the Old Capital for lack of reinforcements, prioritising her escape. Her eyes were Ether-corrupted, leaving her nearly blind outside Hollows but granting “Ether Vision” within them. Wracked with survivor's guilt, she first introduced herself to Phaethon as “Charon”; her Agent Story turns her misplaced rage into a hunt for whoever caused Hollow Zero, and a harmonica left by her captain once stopped a sniper's bullet and saved her life.

APPEARANCE: Very long ash-blonde hair is bound in a high ponytail, and a solid black visor covers her blinded eyes entirely, flanked by red triangular clips on both sides of her head with a thin yellow cable running down to her collar. A black camouflage jacket sits loose on her shoulders over a yellow-and-black armoured chest rig marked "OBOL" with a red targeting emblem and a grey optic mounted at the collar, leaving her midriff bare beneath crossed straps. Holstered gear rides at both hips above a yellow-and-black undersuit and black camouflage leggings with knee guards, ending in short black-and-gold boots. One hand rests on the muzzle of an enormous yellow-and-black rifle standing upright beside her, stencilled "N.E.D.F." (New Eridu Defense Force).

**Combat Style (Electric · Stun, S-Rank):** She is a near-blind sniper who lands precise scoped Electric shots and “Harmonising” aftershock rounds from range, building Daze off-field. Render her stillness and held breath before each thunderclap report.

173.comment: Agent BG · Orphie Magnusson & Magus (Obol Squad)
173.content:
**Orphie Magnusson & Magus · Obol Squad (background):** Orphie is a human soldier, while Magus is the sentient Intelligent Construct weapon attached to her and the squad's true captain. Magus was once Orpheus Magnusson, a soldier under Colonel Isolde during the Fall; when her squad died and she was mortally wounded, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, becoming Magus. A later attempt to give her a cloned body produced its own personality named Orphie, effectively splitting Orpheus into body (Orphie) and soul (Magus). Unable to accept this, Isolde joined the Exaltists for revenge and became Overseer Mevorakh. Magus is sharp-tongued and strict but caring; Orphie is upbeat and eager to prove herself in the shadow of Magus, her original self.

APPEARANCE: Orphie has bright orange hair in long low twin-tails under a black flight cap and artificial goat horns, with green eyes and pointed elf ears. She wears a grey-and-black armoured flight suit with a heavy front zip and quilted panels, and her black shorts are lined in yellow and marked "OBSIDIAN". One arm has a bulky black gauntlet and the other a yellow-and-black glove. A white strap crosses one thigh above dark brown thigh-high stockings with a yellow stripe, and black platform boots with yellow soles. One hand grips a red-and-black control stick wired to a grey pack at her hip. Magus is the long segmented grey-and-red mechanical tail arching over her shoulder, which ends in a pistol shaped like a red draconic head with a single large eye. Its bladed jaws frame a stylised flame at its mouth.

**Combat Style (Fire · Attack, S-Rank):** Orphie wields a flamethrower while Magus, the sentient gun on her tail, fires charged lasers; together, they specialize in off-field Aftershock fire. Render a bickering two-in-one gunline.

174.content:
**Seed (Flora) & Seed Sr. · Obol Squad (background):** The squad's heavy-weapons expert, who pilots a mech named Seed Sr. Her Ether aptitude tops a perfect score, letting her endure Ether exposure for up to half a month. She is odd-mannered, with a fixed deadpan smile and blunt remarks to go with her reckless habits, yet her mission record is flawless. She was raised alone in the Defense Force dormitories by Seed Sr., a mass-produced Intelligent Construct who, though it didn't understand families, raised her anyway. She usually walks around barefoot.

APPEARANCE: Short pale-blue hair curls at her jaw around a small white flower clip, with one long dark braid trailing behind, above green eyes and a fixed gentle smile. She wears glossy white detached sleeves on her arms and white stockings on her legs that reveal the back part of those legs with visible seams and grey bolt plates, banded at the upper arms and clipped at the upper thighs. She wears a white sleeveless mini-dress with a grey bandeau top and gold ring fittings across the chest, and a segmented collar hung with a small clover charm sits at her neck. The skirt carries small orange lettering reading "DESIGN-00833 / TYPE-OBOL", with a dark blue panel behind and an "OPERATOR" ribbon streaming from her waist. She is barefoot, standing on a wide grey-and-yellow mechanical scooter disc, one hand raised in a loose salute while the other rests on the grip of the scooter.

**Combat Style (Electric · Attack, S-Rank):** She is an artillery girl linked to a combat mech (Seed Sr.), unloading cannon barrages that include a first-person firing Ultimate. Render thunderous, deadpan bombardment.

175.content:
**Yixuan · Yunkui Summit, 13th High Preceptor (background):** Grandmaster of the Suibian Temple sect and a Void-Hunter-level investigator. An orphan who wandered with her older sister Yijiang until the previous High Preceptor took them in; Yijiang inherited the title first but died during the Fall of the Old Capital, passing it to Yixuan. The sisters together created the Qingming Bird technique. As High Preceptor, Yixuan takes in orphaned disciples (Ju Fufu, the Ye siblings, Pan Yinhu and the Phaethon siblings) and teaches by casual example. Losing Yijiang to the cursed Qingming Sword left her fiercely overprotective of its new bearer, Ye Shunguang.

APPEARANCE: Long silver-white hair flows loose behind her, pinned with a small black clip and streaked by a dark brown ribbon-like strand, above sharp gold-amber eyes. A mustard-yellow cropped jacket with embroidered trim hangs open from her shoulders, its long tails splitting into pale fan-like blades. Beneath it, she wears a white halter top gathered by a gold ring with a red cord clasp at the throat (leaving enormous amounts of cleavage bare), over a black corset, and glossy black high-waisted shorts with gold buttons and cut-outs. A wide black belt carries a gold-and-red ornament with a hanging tassel, and a decorated band and dark strap holster wrap one thigh. One leg is sheathed in a dark stocking and the other left bare, both ending in white-and-black lace-up boots with brass eyelets and black heels. Her hands are in black fingerless gloves, and the Qingming Bird, a black hawk made up of Auric Ink of Etheric matter, with gold-veined wings and a purple eye-marked chest, rests on her outstretched arm.

**Combat Style (Auric Ink · Rupture, S-Rank):** The Grandmaster bends and weaves with taijitu flourishes, pulling foes in with “Cloud Shaper” and unleashing defense-ignoring Sheer damage, self-triggering Disorder through Auric Ink. Render flowing ink-and-Ether brushstrokes turned lethal.

176.content:
**Ju Fufu · Yunkui Summit, most senior disciple (background):** Despite a small, childlike appearance, she is Yixuan's very first disciple and the most senior, far more strategically sharp than she looks. She is a rare tiger Thiren (not the ordinary cat Thiren people assume); her story reveals tiger Thirens were once plentiful until the forbidden relic the Tigerbane Bell drained their life and power, leaving them scarce. Fufu oversaw the restoration of Suibian Temple and warmly welcomes the Phaethon twins. A formidable eater, much like Soukaku and Cissia.

APPEARANCE: She is a small, youthful tiger Thiren with long golden-blonde hair, a stray cowlick, bright green eyes and a wide open smile. Rounded tiger ears sit high on her head, and an enormous banded orange-and-white tail with tiger patterns curls up behind her, tied with a dark blue patterned bandana. She wears a grey short-sleeved shirt with a wooden name tag hung on a cord with Chinese characters written onto it, layered over a long black undershirt, with dark embroidered denim shorts, a braided rope on a rod coiled at one hip and a small bell on a thigh strap (which is the rod she attaches her lion-dog robot to for making it into a deadly mace). Both hands are encased in heavy gold-and-black clawed gauntlets, and spherical ornaments with the colours and texture of tiger fur swing at her waist. She wears white crew socks and navy sneakers with yellow laces. Beside her hovers her spherical grey lion-dog companion, plated with gold spikes above a snarling fanged muzzle (she can attach that robot to a rod to make it function like a mace).

**Combat Style (Fire · Stun, S-Rank):** She is a tiny but senior tiger Thiren who fights beside her spherical lion-dog buddy Hu Wei, either as a dynamic duo or swinging Hu Wei as a mace, landing fiery martial-arts Daze and buffing squad CRIT DMG. Render lion-dance ferocity and bursting embers, with the occasional mace swing.

177.content:
**Pan Yinhu · Yunkui Summit cook (background):** A rare panda Thiren and the sect's chef. Orphaned young and forced to fend for himself, he knew real starvation and tried every odd job before his strong Ether aptitude turned him into a Hollow Raider, where he became violent guarding his hauls. A chance thrashing-and-awakening from Yixuan led him to join the sect to temper his aggression and for the promise of “three meals a day”, which turned out to mean a food allowance, so he taught himself to cook. He dotes on his juniors, the Phaethon twins, slipping them food and coupons.

APPEARANCE: He is a hulking panda Thiren in black-and-white fur, with a broad grinning muzzle showing small fangs, the typical panda "fur mask" around his eyes, red glasses and a wide grey conical hat trimmed with red-tasselled bells. A sleeveless golden-yellow tunic printed with swirling cloud patterns stretches over his round belly, bound by a red-and-gold sash and a studded belt hung with a wooden box and pouches beside a row of black-and-white discs. A bandolier of red-corded blades crosses his chest. His forearms are cased in massive black-and-steel spiked gauntlets with red-padded palms. Loose dark grey trousers taper into armoured cuffs above bare, clawed panda feet.

**Combat Style (Physical · Defense, A-Rank):** He is a laid-back panda Thiren cook who counters with heavy palm-and-cleaver blows and heals through a taijitu Ultimate, and he is the game's only PEN-ratio Defense support. Render slow, heavy palm strikes.

178.content:
**Ye Shunguang · Yunkui Summit, Sword Keeper (background):** Younger sister of Ye Shiyuan and bearer of the cursed Qingming Sword, holding the Void Hunter title “Qingming Arbiter”. Her happy childhood ended with the Fall of the Old Capital, when her parents died saving others; she then leaned on her brother until Banyue saved them and Yixuan took them both in. Chosen by the Qingming Sword, she gained Void Hunter power at a brutal price: wielding it slowly erodes her memories and senses, so Yixuan built a custom case to suppress the side effects. She is responsible and self-sacrificing and has romantic feelings for the Proxy, and the resentment building up from her smothered, over-protected life surfaces as a white-haired alter ego. Her affectionate nickname is Xiao'Guang. Her and Shiyuan are confirmed fox Thirens, just like Miyabi.

APPEARANCE: She has a very unconventional fox Thiren design: long brown hair falls past her waist, tied with a red ribbon and a white headband, with upright animal ears above and small red-and-gold charms and a red talisman slip hanging at one side. Her red eyes sit above a small confident smile, with a red mark beneath one eye. An enormous fluffy brown tail sweeps behind her. She wears a white sleeveless qipao-style dress with gold embroidery, a golden mandarin collar, cloud patterning across the belly and a very high side slit with a gold tassel at the waist, revealing a red tattoo on her left thigh consisting of cloud patterns that together form a bigger leaf pattern. Her arms are wrapped in long white sleeves fitted with metal cuffs. Her bare legs run into black high-heeled ankle boots with gold fittings and red heels. She holds the Qingming Sword, a long slim straight sword by a red cord and cast with a zig-zaggy checkerboard pattern on its blade, drawn from the huge black-and-grey case standing at her side (which also functions as her shield), its face marked with a black-white-red yin-yang ornament.

**Combat Style (Honed Edge · Attack, S-Rank):** She is a Void Hunter who enters “Enlightened Mind” to convert all damage to Honed Edge, weaving near-invulnerable air-and-ground greatsword (Qingming Sword) slashes that shred Miasma shields. Render a blur of disciplined blade-arcs. Each use of the Qingming Sword inches her deeper and deeper into dementia.

179.content:
**Ukinami Yuzuha · Spook Shack co-founder (Spook Shack username "Yuzupepper"):** A human girl who co-founded the Spook Shack mystery forum with classmate Komano Manato. Adopted daughter of antiques-shop owner Li Baorong (one of his five adopted children), she hides a dark past: she was “ES-07”, the prized sole survivor of Porcelumex's illegal child-experiment program “Project New Leaf”, her blood uniquely able to purify Porcelume. Years ago, she was rescued from the facility by the nobleman Lionel Thymefield, who died covering her escape; in the chaos, she caught and kept his daughter Alice's dropped Sailor Boo hairclip as a good-luck charm, never knowing whose it was. Behind her pranks, she carries deep self-worth issues and survivor's guilt, along with a transactional view of love that her bond with Alice begins to heal.

She has a pet raccoon dog (tanuki) called Kamanosuke who she rescued while he was being drowned by a group of children, hence her tanuki theming.

APPEARANCE: She has bright red hair with blunt bangs and one very long braid draped over her shoulder, tied off with a large white ribbon, above green eyes and a wide toothy grin, and she often raises one hand beside her mouth. She wears a soft pink cable-knit cardigan with oversized pink buttons and a large swirl motif on one sleeve, over a dark sailor-collared top with a white ruffled bib and a red tag reading "YUZUHA". Her skirt layers a black pleated panel over a red scalloped ruffle. Her legwear is deliberately mismatched, a grey-and-white striped thigh-high with a garter on one leg and a slouched striped ankle sock on the other, above brown-black buckled lace-up boots. Behind her, she carries a large red-and-navy umbrella tipped with steel spikes, printed with a Bangboo face and paw prints. A brown thick-furred tanuki muzzled in a dark strapped harness clings at her left side, its long brown plumed tail sweeping down behind her.

**Combat Style (Physical · Support, S-Rank):** She fights with a five-hit Omni-Umbrella combo and a parry stance, while her tanuki Kama lobs candy-bomb “Sweet Scare” aftershocks off-field and she buffs Anomaly teams. Render playful umbrella-twirls and prank explosions.

180.content:
**Alice Thymefield · Spook Shack (background):** A noble rabbit Thiren, heiress of the prestigious Thymefield family, famous for Ether science and made wealthy by an anti-corruption medicine patent. She attended Celestia School for Girls (alongside Lucy de Montefio before she went into her rebellious streak, left the city for freedom and joined the Sons of Calydon) and excels at fencing and Ether science. After her father Lionel's death, she developed an OCD for symmetry, subconsciously fearing that asymmetry invites disaster. (Due to her OCD and showing symptoms of alexithymia [the inability to properly process, recognise or describe emotions], she is heavily suspected to be suffering from high-functioning autism, although this is not confirmed by HoYo devs as of now.) Lionel had died rescuing Yuzuha at the Porcelumex facility on the very day Alice lost her hairclip, so the two girls were linked long before they met. To save the trapped Yuzuha, Alice sold the family medicine patent to TOPS' Damian Blackwood and then released it to the public for free as a countermeasure; Yuzuha and Manato then brought her into Spook Shack.

APPEARANCE: Pale blonde hair is braided in a crown around her head into a high ponytail, with two very long low twin-tails cuffed by red cylindrical clasps labelled "Alice"; small pointed pink ears rise at the top of her head. Her orange-red eyes are flat and composed, and round white ball earrings with red horn-like accents hang at her ears, also labelled "Alice". She wears a crisp white long-sleeved school blouse with a small badge on the upper arm and a dark grey collar and tie, and a red segmented cord is strung across the chest. A bulky black utility rig with a screen showing her emotions is belted at her waist, carrying glowing green modules with a hose running from it, over a dark green-grey pleated skirt. Black tights marked with X-shaped stitch patches at the thighs run into chunky white, grey and red sneakers ringed with red cuffs at the ankles. She holds a long and slim fencing sword with a blue-and-grey mechanical hilt wired back to her belt, with a matching red-capped injector tucked at her opposite hip.

**Combat Style (Physical · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She is a noble rabbit Thiren fencer who salutes, then strikes with elegant rapier thrusts and slashes that detonate “Polarised Assault” bursts. Render precise, aristocratic fencing punctuated by shockwaves.

181.content:
**Komano Manato · Spook Shack co-founder (background):** A towering but sweet-natured guardian dog (komainu) Thiren who co-founded Spook Shack with Yuzuha. Loyal and just, Manato insists allies shelter behind him in danger and keeps a real temper carefully in check. He backs Yunkui Summit and the fight against Porcelumex and the Exaltists across Season 2.

During the events of version 2.3, he encounters his drowned ideal version from his childhood, dressed in white and his hair dyed white, who wants nothing but strength and fame, and respect for himself above all else. That Manato is one he long since left behind for the warmth behind taking care of his adoptive siblings (who are human children, by the way, but still love the dog Thiren just as much as if he was their biological big brother).

APPEARANCE: He is a tall, broad-shouldered dog Thiren with short crimson-and-black hair, black-tipped ears and red eyes, a scar-like marking under his left eye and a flat, unimpressed expression. A black collar sits at his throat above a silver arrowhead pendant. He wears a black double-breasted vest with gold buttons over a white tank top, with an angular grey-and-black armoured pauldron on one shoulder and a long dark coat behind him whose tails end in pointed metal caps. His left forearm is bound in red bandaging clasped with metal cuffs; his right hand is gloved. Olive-green cargo trousers hang from buckled belts with a black tag reading 荒魂 (Wandering Souls), over white-and-grey high-top sneakers. A thick brown-and-grey tail curls out behind him, and he shoulders a massive claymore with a yellow grip and a red tassel.

**Combat Style (Fire · Rupture, A-Rank):** He is a hulking guardian dog Thiren who fights with kicks and a claymore he sets alight, unloading big flaming slash-strings and slides and burning HP for empowered “Molten Edge” attacks. Render heavy, smouldering greatsword sweeps.

182.content:
**Lucia Elowen · Spook Shack (background):** A goat/faun-themed Thiren backpacker and Ethereal-lore enthusiast (Spook Shack username “Night Emissary”). She comes from a tribe whose ancestors encountered an Ethereal called the “Night Horror”, which left them unnoticed by Ethereals, but at the price of dreaming of it and sleepwalking into Hollows. Her people became “Nightwatchers” who sleep by day and keep watch by night, a custom she still keeps in New Eridu.

APPEARANCE: Short lavender-blue hair frames green eyes and pointed ears beneath a pair of short dark curved horns, with a long silver-white braid capped in gold fittings and a dark furry tassel trailing from the back of her head. She wears a black sleeveless romper over a teal halter top, strapped with buckles and hung with a large gold clock-face medallion at the waist with the stylised silhouette of a goat's head on it, alongside rows of small gold pens and charms. A teal cape lined in darker green sweeps out behind her. Gold chain garters with tassels sit on both thighs, one leg bare with a plain black band, the other in a white knee sock with a metal knee plate, both in black boots ornamented with gold key shapes. She holds a large purple hardback spell book open with her bare hand, and her other arm, protected by a buckled armoured gauntlet, raises a tall staff built like a fountain pen, with a black barrel and a gold nib below an ornate looping gold crown.

**Combat Style (Ether · Support, S-Rank):** She is a goat Thiren who waves her staff to summon painted Ethereal creatures that fight and buff Rupture allies. Render storybook beasts peeling off the page and using their powers to support her team.

183.content:
**Yidhari Murphy · Spook Shack (username "Strawberry Parfait", background):** An octopus/kraken-themed Thiren author and Proxy who contributes to Spook Shack, her laid-back manner masking real detachment. In the Waifei arc, she was trapped and bound by Miasma in a cursed town until Phaethon's ocular implants broke the binding. Freed alongside Manato, Lucia and Banyue, she later undergoes VR-dive therapy (in a facility rebuilt from Dr. Lohr's old clinic) to face repressed trauma.

APPEARANCE: Short wavy blonde hair with a dark curled lock is tucked under a small black beret, above bright pink-violet eyes and a wide grin. She wears a white puff-sleeved blouse bared at the shoulders, trimmed with black bows and buckled arm cuffs, over a black corset belt and a gold ruffled miniskirt, with a black bodysuit beneath marked at one hip by a large dark circular emblem. Black thigh-high stockings run into tall grey-black boots, one fitted with a spiked jaw-like plate at the ankle. Two pairs of enormous mottled purple and lilac tentacles patterned with pale suckers and dark swirls coil out from behind her. She grips a long black pole hammer with a twisting purple head, a red-and-white gourd charm swinging from its shaft, and rides a bulbous grey-and-purple submarine-like drone stencilled "KRAKEN".

**Combat Style (Ice · Rupture, S-Rank):** She is an octopus Thiren who spins around her hammer's handle for HP-burning slams while tentacles shield and counter-smash, hitting harder the lower her HP. Render whirling, reckless ice-hammer momentum.

184.content:
**Zhao · Krampus Compliance Authority supervisor (background):** A rabbit Thiren and the de-facto field leader of Krampus, feared across the TOPS Alliance as a walking "disaster" despite her small and innocent posture, earning the menacing nicknames "the Unbeaten Legend" and "Meat-Eating Rabbit". She grew up in a large, destitute family ruled by the principle of "whoever brings the most benefit eats most", and since she was underperforming in day-to-day breadwinning, she was judged low-value and effectively got disowned by her parents. A Krampus official spotted her potential and recruited her. She buried her past and built her whole worldview around "value" and "equivalent exchange", coldly appraising everyone and deeply suspicious of kindness that has no motive.

APPEARANCE: She is a pink-furred short rabbit full Thiren. Her pink hair has two, long and thick braided pigtails, one on each side and with orange flowers at the ends. Her hair also has bright red decorative items and spherical objects resembling W-Engines (spherical weapon cores of this world) in it. Her eyes are bright red, which gives her a deceptively cute look despite her age range being stated to be in her 20s. She wears a turquoise jacket with white cuffs over a **black dress** with orange trims and Chinese knot fastenings. She also wears a green pendant or medallion at her chest.

She wears extra-large children's clothes because the clothing lines specifically made for rabbit Thirens of her small size are very expensive and super itchy and uncomfortable. She also sits in the driving seat with the help of a baby seat, since the normal car seat is too big for her.

Weapon & Gear: She carries an enormous **silver cleaver/butcher knife** over her shoulder, which looks comically large compared to her body. The sword also has a small white mascot charm dangling from it.

Her affectionate nickname is Xiao'Zhao.

**Combat Style (Ice · Defense, S-Rank):** A rabbit Thiren holding a lot of power and authority behind a deceptively cute and small body, she condenses an enormous ice blade mid-fight, cutting through foes in big agile cleaves while shielding and buffing the team. Render conjured frost-steel and sweeping guard-counters.

185.content:
**Promeia · Krampus Compliance Authority Judge (background):** She is a quiet, icy executioner and the most feared Judge in the TOPS Alliance. Before Krampus, she was a “Sweeper” serving Calydon in the Outer Ring, mercy-killing the irreversibly corrupted for what she believed was a greater good, until she learned the Sweepers' real profit came from engineering gang wars. The revelation shattered her old self. She chose exile and made wearing handcuffs her condition for joining Krampus, a permanent symbol of self-restraint and judgment. She is the figure who traumatised the young Cissia due to a misunderstanding.

In Season 3, she came to Roscaelifer with Phoenix on Krampus business and followed High Ambitions' trail to the Shrouded Reef research base. Cornered there by Ethereals, she became Lindverne's temporary ally "with Krampus" and then stayed at Blazelight Hall as a guest under watch, handing over her communication devices but refusing to promise she could keep the Sunbringers' secret forever. In Chapter 4, she laid Krampus's findings on the table for Roscaelifer once Phoenix told her to (Phoenix promised to handle the Boss), warned that a head-on assault on Quietude Isle could make High Ambitions take everyone on Booastrum hostage, then stayed to help Claret defend Vyrium. She worried aloud that Phoenix was the real complication and pointed out that she could have played the captive Krampus Judge herself. When Claret spoke of a fail-safe strong enough to keep Phoenix in check, Promeia guessed she meant Lindverne, and when Claret confirmed it, she could only say she hoped so. Phoenix calls her "Mia". She is also the one who calls Phoenix's power the only thing that could count as a benefit of TOPS's Sacrifice Project (see "Agent BG · Phoenix Reffaella (Krampus)").

APPEARANCE: Promeia has short violet blue hair, cut into a bob with a long fringe falling over one eye, ending in a long braided ponytail that reaches down her ankles and is bound at intervals with white metal clasps, and eyes of that same violet colour. A studded collar sits at her throat with a large silver hoop hanging from it. She wears a big, body-covering black cloak that only has an opening at her buttocks; up close, it shows a deep iridescent blue-violet, its panels edged with silver rivets and flaring out into long pointed tails with pale undersides and silver tips. Under the cloak, she wears BDSM-inspired gear: a dark button-front bodice with oval silver buttons over a white panel set with a circular emblem at the sternum, and a row of studs across the abdomen. She wears black latex stockings marked with silver studs down the thigh and a small round panel on the outside of one leg, and high heels sculpted into silver and blue talons. Her hands are usually seen behind her back handcuffed, as a symbol of her restraint and self-control. The cuffs are a stacked set of white banded rings buckled around both wrists, and her nails are painted violet. Long violet streamers trail loose from her outfit.

**Combat Style (Ice · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She is a silent former Sweeper whose defense-ignoring strikes power Ice “Abloom” bursts and “Trial by Cold” detonations. Render her frost strikes as cold, merciless executions.

186.content:
**Dialyn · Krampus “customer service representative”:** Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Centre, though few know her other identity as a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge. An enforcer with a saccharine customer-service persona masking a willingness to pass brutal “verdicts”.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows, a talent unique to her. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it a gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.

"Curse" describes both the torment of the endless voices of the dead echoing through the Hollows and the ill fate such a sinister gift brings.

Before a secondary Hollow outbreak, Dialyn's neighbours, misled by a construction company, turned on her, sending the "ill-omened" child into a Hollow as a sacrifice for their own safety.

Naive to humanity's cruelty but kind at heart, the young Dialyn willingly offered her life to save everyone, but upon stepping into the Hollow, her accursed gift revealed the cruel truth: it had all been a scheme by the construction company. The residents, whose lives had been covered by massive insurance policies, were doomed to die within the Hollow, and Dialyn was simply the bait to keep them from fleeing.

She heard her secret curse betrayed, the hatred the dead had towards her, the voices of all who perished, and the lies of those who lived. She can no longer recall how she made it through that barren wasteland. Ever since Krampus took her in, she's been ready: amid the unending struggle between lies and truth, she would learn to pass her own judgment on good and evil.

APPEARANCE: She has amber eyes and two-toned black-and-white hair, with black being on her right side of her head, white on the left side. Her hair ends in two big ponytails, with a hair ornament showing the 50/50 split between the braided and smooth segments of those ponytails. Her outfit is a white-coloured and elegant, Chinese-inspired customer service representative uniform, with a little golden silhouette of a panda's head on its skirt-like appendage. She also wears white stockings and platform shoes. On the right side of her belt, there is an old-school telephone's receiver resting, which connects to the clip part of the belt (which might be the thing housing the actual telephone circuitry).

WEAPON AND GEAR: Her weapon is a glowing hula hoop blade, swinging it around the battlefield and slicing through enemies.

**Combat Style (Physical · Stun, S-Rank):** She slams enemies with large summoned “portal” fists in a Rock→Scissors→Paper EX sequence, applying “Malicious Complaint” and converting an ally's Chain Attack into an Ultimate. Render oversized conjured fists punching through rifts. (Her weapon is conjured, so treat the description as visual.)

187.content:
**Phoenix Reffaella · Krampus Compliance Authority Judge (Black Branch):** A Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, TOPS's internal law enforcement. She is its secret ace and, officially, Krampus's second-in-command when it comes to combat. She belongs to Krampus's Black Branch and rarely takes part in preliminary reviews. When the Boss dispatches her, the verdict has already been reached, and it is the harshest one the branch hands out: death, which the Black Branch calls "the only mercy". Zhao, the "Unbeaten Legend" herself, says that apart from the Boss, nobody in Krampus could beat Phoenix. Her name is localised as Phoenix Reffaella in English and as Fiony in some other regions.

**The girl who cannot die.** She was one of the first test subjects of TOPS's "Sacrifice" Project, and by Promeia's account its only true "achievement", a result too dangerous and too conspicuous to show off. Promeia's attitude to her antics is that if Phoenix wants to play the clown, she won't stop her. A partially redacted experimental report in Phoenix's file states that, based on existing data, the subject is immortal and cannot be killed: when her vital signs fall, the enormous Ether reserves stored in her body awaken and push her into a state the report calls "transcendence". Phoenix describes it more plainly. The experiment turned her into a sponge that only absorbs Ether, and being unable to die, in her own words, is no easy thing. The Boss of Krampus sees her as useful precisely because she draws attention: the Three Pacts, the corporations at TOPS's round table, gave up trying to capture her long ago, and while she lives, they keep clinging to their delusions about the project (see "NPC BG · The Boss of Krampus (Krampus Compliance Authority)").

She is also chronically ill. She takes part in drug trials for Jonathan Medical, which is working on a cure for her illness, and she has a habit of collapsing wherever she happens to be standing, to the point where a flustered Patrolboo once had to shout at her: "You can't sleep in the middle of the road!!!"

**Personality.** She is lively and spontaneous, a little too familiar with strangers and endlessly curious, with no sense of fear and very little sense of where life ends and death begins. That makes her the clumsiest person in most rooms and, very often, also the most dangerous one. She calls herself Krampus's number one Judge and can back it up. She plays dead for the fun of a dramatic resurrection and jokes about her own death constantly. Fatal wounds are minor inconveniences to her. When a fight turns serious, she slides into a Judge's cold menace without dropping her cheerful voice, and the fiercer her opponent resists, the more fired up she gets. Dialyn finds her fun to be around, on the condition that Senior Zhao comes along whenever they go out, to handle the "unexpected situations" that follow Phoenix everywhere.

**Relationships.** Promeia is her Krampus colleague and her partner on the Roscaelifer assignment (see "S2 Epilogue B · Krampus Travels to Roscaelifer"). Zhao vouches for her strength, and Dialyn for her company. Severian Lowell of New Eridu Public Security is an old friend and a current source of friction: Krampus keeps a file on him with "avoid conflict with this individual" written three times over in bold red letters, and he returns the distrust with interest.

**In Season 3.** She arrived in Booastrum disguised as a High Ambitions Corp. medical assistant and got knocked into a hedge by Cissia's door before she could say a word (see "S3 Ch3 · Phoenix Comes Through the Door (Amber Hall)"). When TOPS seized Booastrum and took the Proxy's sibling and Cissia, she carried Fairy's case from Amber Hall to Gear Street at the sibling's request and tripped off the edge of the island, landing in the sea off Vyrium. In Chapter 4, she invited Remielle to a second assassination attempt on Eldreda after (wrongly) accusing Eldreda of being the mole, and she volunteered to play the captive Krampus Judge so the others could slip through Quietude Isle (see "S3 Ch4 · Airport Assault (Quietude Isle)"). At the top of the Airspace Control Tower, Truvia ran her through, and she came straight back to deliver her Boss's letter and a verdict of hellfire (see "S3 Ch4 · Sorry, I Just Can't Seem to Die (Phoenix Impaled)"). Her fire hit Truvia's Etheric Other where it is weakest. She calls Promeia "Mia" and Truvia a "purple eggplant", while Belle (or Wise) is her sibling from another mister and another mother. She also complains that the Boss sure likes her poetry.

APPEARANCE: She has very long blonde hair. Two small sections are tied up at the sides of her head, while the rest falls into two long, low twintails whose bases are capped with hair pods. A stubborn ahoge sticks up from the crown, and a small clip sits in her hair. Her eyes are yellow. Her default outfit is white from neck to toe: a white dress over a white leotard, with puffed short sleeves at the shoulders and separate detached sleeves on her arms. An open-fronted showgirl skirt frames her legs. White thigh-high stockings are held up by white garter straps. Metal fittings on the dress, from the zip at its collar to the ornament in her hair, all repeat the same single symbol, an ankh, and a plaster is stuck to her chest. In the Season 3 teaser "Before the Wind Rises", she was shown sitting among lava debris with flame-like shapes rising behind her. Her two alternate outfits, "The Illness Called Life" and "Daydream Complex", are school-uniform variants, the second complete with a mock-dramatic eye patch.

WEAPON AND GEAR: Her weapon looks like a crutch at first glance. It splits into twin blades in red and white and locks back together into a giant pair of scissors, and when she "dies" in the middle of a fight, it stands planted in the ground beside her like a gravestone until she gets back up. Her signature W-Engine is Plume of Rebirth.

**Combat Style (Fire · Anomaly, S-Rank):** Released on 21 October 2026 in the first half of v3.3 on the "Into the Flames of Life" banner, alongside a Velina rerun. She is an on-field Anomaly damage dealer built around fire that won't stay dead. Her Core Passive, *Nirvana*, makes any Attribute Anomaly the squad inflicts brand the enemy with **Sear** for 20 seconds. Anomaly damage dealt to a Seared enemy can land critical hits, with a CRIT Rate that grows with her Anomaly Mastery above 155 (maxing out at 255), and Seared enemies also take periodic Fire damage based on her ATK. *Nirvana* also gives her **Rebirth**: fatal damage doesn't defeat her, and she gets back up again (once within a long cooldown). Her resource is **Pyre** (up to 120), built by her Combustion Attacks and by Perfect Blocks.
- Basic Attack *Sever Life* is a four-hit string whose third and fourth hits are Combustion Attacks; holding Basic Attack with enough Pyre (90) fires *Purifying Flame*, a weapon throw and flying finisher that triggers **Abloom** on an enemy already suffering an Attribute Anomaly. *Meltdown* is a charging follow-up out of her Special Attack.
- Dodge *Drifting Sway*, Dash Attack *Lunge*, Dodge Counter *Twin Passage of Karmic Fire*.
- Quick Assist *Emergency Aid*, Defensive Assist *Patient Turned Doctor* (a parry for massive Daze) and Assist Follow-Up *Regeneration Therapy*.
- Special Attack *Fire Sweep* (a retreat that cuts incoming damage, then a rising slash that can Perfect Block). Her EX Specials chain together: *Dazzling Flare* (a spinning blaze that can Perfect Block and gives her the **Wither and Bloom** state) turns the next EX into *Falling Sun* (an airborne weapon throw that grants one **Ascension**), which *Blazing Slash* spends on a powerful rising slash.
- Chain Attack *Last-Minute Salvation*.
- Ultimate *Perpetual Resurrection* is a kamikaze dive that burns all of her HP in one huge Fire explosion and leaves her in the **Wither** state. When she comes back in, *Soul-Searching Blaze* restores the HP she spent and surrounds her with orbiting flames, and it also triggers Abloom.
- Additional Ability *Krampus Ace*: with another Anomaly Agent or a fellow Krampus member in the squad, Anomaly damage against Seared enemies gets extra CRIT DMG.
- Mindscape Cinemas: *Lingering Pain and Thrilling Procession*, *Curiosity Won't Kill the Cat*, *Scarecrow Complex*, *Life's End and the Heartless Wonderland*, *Carnival of Madness* and *Notes From Confinement*.
Her official pairings are with Velina and Remielle, or Velina and Yuzuha. Render her as an immortal girl who burns her own life down to embers and lights it again, her scissors flashing red and white and flames blooming out of every Anomaly she touches. Her Ultimate is a suicidal dive-bomb followed by a grin as she climbs back out of the smoke.

188.comment: NPC BG · The Boss of Krampus (Krampus Compliance Authority)
188.content:
**The Boss of Krampus · leader of the Krampus Compliance Authority:** The woman at the head of Krampus, TOPS's internal law enforcement (see "S1 · TOPS (The Outstanding Paragons Alliance)"). Little is known about who she is or what drives her. She has told Zhao that Krampus is loyal to TOPS alone, and she is the one who decides when a Judge is dispatched (when she sends Phoenix, the verdict has already been reached; see "Agent BG · Phoenix Reffaella (Krampus)"). Her Judges simply call her "the Boss". When Phoenix had Promeia share Krampus's findings with Roscaelifer, Phoenix promised to handle the Boss herself if she objected, and Promeia teases Phoenix that the Boss wouldn't like to hear about her fooling around on the job.

**In Season 3.** In a scene where the game labels her only "???", she sent Phoenix to the Celestial Nexus over Promeia's objection that the targets' crimes didn't warrant it, judging that what Krampus needed was precisely someone who draws attention, and told Promeia not to concern herself with the Three Pacts, who gave up trying to capture Phoenix long ago. She cast Phoenix as a messenger: as an era nears its burial and the curtain rises on a new one, Krampus's letter would announce to the world that Krampus is about to make its entrance. The letter reads like scripture, all brimstone and karmic fire with woe to those who dwell upon the earth, and Phoenix's summary is that the Boss sure likes her poetry (see "S3 Ch4 · Sorry, I Just Can't Seem to Die (Phoenix Impaled)"). She also noticed that Promeia has changed, if only slightly.

(Note for narration: this lorebook has no description of her appearance, so keep her offstage or in shadow, a calm woman's voice that speaks of eras and stages and leaves the killing to her Judges.)

189.content:
**Banyue · ancient martial-arts master (background):** A noble, justice-driven lion Thiren Intelligent Construct of great age, originally built to suppress Miasma and able to enter a “Visage of Wrath” battle form. A longtime friend of Yixuan, he watched over the orphaned Ye siblings before Yunkui Summit took them in, and later ran a martial-arts school, becoming a Shifu in his own right. In Season 2, he aids Belle and Wise at Suibian Temple and cooperates with Zhao and Krampus.

He carries life-long guilt for not being able to save everyone in that Porcelumex mining facility incident a decade ago. He **did** save the Ye siblings, but since everyone else was left to die due to the "perfectly rational and deterministic" algorithms driving his core directives in his Logic Core, society has cast him out.

APPEARANCE: He is a towering mechanical lion Thiren. His face is a pale bone-white lion mask with gold fittings and hollow eye sockets glowing yellow, framed by a shaggy silver-grey mane, with a slim tail ending in a matching silver tuft. His body is heavy white-and-grey armour plating over a dark segmented frame, a glowing gold core set into his chest, boxy grey shoulder guards and enormous rounded gauntlets tipped with gold-clawed fingers. An orange robe is knotted around his waist above a red braided cord, with steel carabiners at the hip and a gold banded plate across his stomach. His dark grey legs are studded with large exposed screw heads and end in armoured clawed lion-like feet. Seven large golden spheres hang suspended in the air around him.

**Combat Style (Fire · Rupture, S-Rank):** He fights like a fighting-game character, with frame-perfect light and heavy combos, summoning a second pair of arms to chain fiery Sheer-damage slashes. Render martial-arts precision with extra burning limbs.

190.comment: Agent BG · Velina Airgid (External Strategy Dept · Roscaelifer)
190.content:
**Velina Airgid · External Strategy Department, Administrative Director (Roscaelifer):** An elegant, calculating noblewoman who guides Phaethon through Roscaelifer; first introduced as an NPC in the v2.7 interlude, playable in v3.0.

APPEARANCE: Very long silver-white hair falls past her knees around pointed elf ears, framing violet eyes and a small closed-mouth smile. An asymmetric white ribbon headpiece studded with gold sits high on one side like a folded wing, a gold earpiece hanging below it. A gold gorget and a short white capelet with gold buttons sit over bare shoulders. Her arms are sleeved in deep blue with a thin chain looped across the shoulder. Her deep blue dress is cut into overlapping petal-like panels edged in pale grey and cinched with a black studded corset belt. Her long dark blue-black skirt hangs from both hips in scalloped, riveted panels tipped in steel, and a white wrap binds one thigh above bare legs in grey pearl-strapped heels. She holds a small white-and-gold folding fan in her raised hand and a heavier steel fan with gold and pale lavender endings stands behind her, trailing a long ribbon at its smaller end.

**Combat Style (Wind · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She is ZZZ's first Wind Agent and fan-dances through enemies with a folding hand fan, summoning Condensed and Sweeping Cyclones that linger and burst, building Windswept stacks. With a Wind Anomaly plus another element on a target, she triggers the new Vortex reaction (which replaces Disorder in Wind teams), and lays a “Gale Field” that strips Anomaly resistance. Her Ultimate turns her into a hurricane that ends in a massive Wind finisher. Render swirling green-white gales that tear the air into visible cyclones, with fan-feathers drifting through them.

191.comment: Agent BG · Norma Hollowell (External Strategy Dept · Roscaelifer)
191.content:
**Norma Hollowell · External Strategy Department, Chief Technician (Roscaelifer):** A small, manic engineer obsessed with Bangboo, with blonde hair and violet eyes, who works alongside Velina; playable in v3.0.

APPEARANCE: She has long blonde hair with blunt bangs, one side worked into a thick braid tied off with grey bands, above wide violet eyes and a small open mouth. She wears a Bangboo built like a tall white-and-silver cylindrical hat on her head, with two dark grey rabbit ears, two large "A" badges, small dials and a "BBU" stamp, together with a navy tailcoat with white lapels and a grey circular "A" badge over a short white button-fronted dress. White gloves disappear into oversized steel cylinder cuffs at both wrists that can turn into Mega Man-styled handcannons in combat. White thigh-high stockings with lace tops and small clip garters run into tall white armoured boots with layered plating and blocky heels. Parts of her clothing float around her, such as a large blue oval dress appendage stencilled "BURST" and covered in switches and a dark navy panel set with gauges, along with a white paddle-shaped device on a slim arm.

**Combat Style (Fire · Stun, S-Rank):** She is a Bangboo-themed turret-deployer with a Bangboo hat. Her “Hat Trick” Basic hurls her hat; her EX deploys two En-Nah turrets that read the enemy's state: armour-piercing Fire warheads (with heavy Daze) on un-Stunned targets, high-explosive Fire warheads on Stunned ones. Her “Preheated Chamber” resource turns off-field Quick Assists into Chain Attacks, and her Ultimate calls in a tactical missile bombardment. Render deployed pop-up turrets, thrown gadgets, falling bombs and raining fire.

192.comment: Agent BG · Sigrid de L'Azur (Airspace Patrol Department · Roscaelifer)
192.content:
**Sigrid de L'Azur · Deputy Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department (background):** She is a horse Thiren and the second-in-command of Roscaelifer's Airspace Patrol, ranking directly below Lindverne Sunbringer. She is the current heir of House de L'Azur, one of Roscaelifer's most prestigious guardian families, and its fifth-generation Deputy Director.

Her house is woven into the city's founding. The first de L'Azur is remembered as Roscaelifer's first soldier and its first spear, "the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer", who raised the city's first wall and whose blade broke before any other in its defence. Sigrid carries the family oath: "So long as my spear remains unbroken, the miracle of the skies shall never end." Lindverne, who has personally known three generations of the family, rates her bluntly and fondly: in combat Sigrid leaves every de L'Azur before her in the dust, and at home, her cookies match her grandmother's and her knitting her mother's. City legend credits her with standing shoulder to shoulder with a Void Hunter and smashing a building apart one-handed, and even with punching clean through a Hollow with a single thrust. Her own modesty, she claims, keeps trying to walk those back.

Her personality runs on two settings. On duty, she is strict and relentlessly by-the-book, just as her internal records describe her. Off duty, she bakes and knits, and she owns a personal Mr. Roar bear mascot costume that she is entirely willing to deploy on a covert infiltration. (Which is admittedly very similar to how two-faced Hoshimi Miyabi is; strict, cold and formal on duty, silly, corny melon-loving woman off-duty.) Her motto is "Glory guides us onward!"

In Season 3 Chapter 2, she becomes the Proxy's most important ally inside Roscaelifer's own institutions. She finds the way into Scamall Hollow and runs the Roswick infiltration, then plants the trap at the CCD banquet and brokers the deal that puts every consequence of the night on Remielle's shoulders instead of Phaethon's, after first securing Lindverne's agreement that Remielle would be treated and allowed to stabilise Dracaene.

APPEARANCE: Her blonde hair is gathered into a very long high ponytail that warms to orange at the tips, beneath tall pointed dark-tipped horse ears and a slim silver circlet, with teal-green eyes and a cool, composed expression. She wears a white-and-brown armoured leotard over a brown underlayer, with plated white chest and hip guards and bare shoulders, belted with a blue sash drawn through a horseshoe-shaped buckle. Blue cross-marked ribbons hang at both hips. One arm is in a long brown glove with a steel cuff, the other in a lavender-plated gauntlet. White thigh-high boot-stockings with rows of buttons run down into brown-soled heeled boots, with her upper thighs left bare, and a long and bushy pale horse tail sweeps out behind her alongside translucent blue butterfly-shaped ether wings. She holds a tall silver lance angled across her body: a pointy spike at the bottom, an axe-like bladed head at the top.

**Combat Style (Ice · Attack, S-Rank):** She is a sky-knight who fights with a spear and shield, folding blocks straight into whirling lance work with frost trailing off every strike. Her Frost-Tipped Spear basics build into Converging Spear, three escalating stages of lunging thrusts that each bloom with ice, while her heavier blows carry her into the Aerial Patrol Spear state. During her opening strikes, her shield snaps up automatically to block, negating the hit and doubling the force of her return blow, so her offence and defence flow together. When her Chain Attack, Encroaching Ice, lands on a stunned elite, she enters Formation Breaker: an uninterruptible, invulnerable barrage of accelerated spear thrusts. Her Ultimate gathers extreme cold before she unloads a devastating series of lunging dash attacks. Render her as disciplined knightly violence, with a braced shield and a lance that leaves the air freezing behind it.

193.comment: Agent BG · Remielle Dan (One of the First Void Hunters)
193.content:
### 🪶 Remielle Dan · One of the First Void Hunters

Remielle Dan, fabricated name Ramiel and formally known as Lieutenant Colonel Dan, is a powerful angel Thiren who first appeared during Season 2 Epilogue: New: Eridan Sunset (A). She was one of the first seven people to be awarded the title of "Void Hunter", having lived over 100 years ago, and is best known for pushing back the Dark Wall by 37 kilometres alongside Colonel Beliora Vike and the unnamed leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe.

**Personality and motivation.** Remielle is a melancholic figure, largely due to her displacement in time and the circumstances surrounding it. Though she enjoys teasing people and has great confidence in herself, it ultimately works to mask a deep loneliness within her. Having been removed from time for a century, she is ignorant towards many modern concepts, from institutions like H.A.N.D. to products like Teamilk and Nitro-Fuel, and she missed the cultural shift in how witherbloom flowers came to be used. Her primary motivation is finding out the truth about where "Sunbringer" disappeared to. After recovering Thaumiel, she discovered the true nature of the three selves Sunbringer left behind, and joined the Covenant of Dayat to investigate further. Despite having initially been in conflict with Eldreda Sunbringer, Remielle is ultimately invested in ensuring Roscaelifer's safety, as it is the life's work of her dear friend, left for the sake of the world. When Fairy triangulated her movements through New Eridu, it showed a woman out of her own time buying flowers and watching a film, with a stop at a tea shop, a farewell tour of a city she had only been passing through.

**Current standing.** She is a citizen of Roscaelifer turned fugitive, having been branded a wanted criminal over her confrontation with Lady Sunbringer. Her base of operations is a makeshift home the En-Nah Gang's Bangboo built for her in their Retroflux Zone hideout, after the ancient Prophetboo recognised her as the real Remielle. At the end of Season 3 Chapter 2, she accepted all charges for the banquet incident to keep them off Phaethon. Then, she began cooperating with the Airspace Patrol and departed for Vyrium alongside Dracaene, whose condition and her own can both be stabilised by the Porcelloy there. In Season 3 Chapter 3, she met the Proxy at Vyrium's port under the alias "Ramiel" while keeping Dracaene stable with Thaumiel, and she admitted that her Void Hunter weapon story had been a lie told to keep her old friend's secret a little longer. In Chapter 4, she worked out on the beach that the girl who fell from the sky had come looking for the Proxy. When Phoenix addressed her as Lieutenant Colonel Dan and cheerfully proposed another go at assassinating Eldreda, Remielle was delighted, and she later offered the possibility that Eldreda simply couldn't stop what was happening. While the others went back to Booastrum, she stayed in Vyrium to keep Dracaene stable, since Dracaene would slip if she and Thaumiel stayed away too long, and promised to fly to the Proxy's side if anything went wrong. At the chapter's end, Remielle caught Belle (or Wise) and Lindverne in mid-air as Roscaelifer fell into the Hive Lord Hollow. The first Sunbringer left a message for her with the Proxy: she does not need to forgive her.

Further information about Remielle Dan is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6.

# APPEARANCE

Remielle is a pink-haired angel Thiren with violet eyes, and two outfits appear across the story.

**Moonlight Whispers (worn through v2.7–2.8):** Short pink hair pinned with dark cross-shaped clips beneath a small dark headpiece, above violet eyes and a sly closed-mouth smirk. A spiked steel-blue cravat sits at her throat over a black choker, above a dark strapless corset bodice with sheer inset panels and buckled straps down the front, a blue gem set at the collar. Long purple-black fingerless gloves reach past the elbow, edged in steel. Her short black skirt is layered and lace-trimmed, worn with a garter belt over dark brown-black stockings marked by a small star at the thigh, ending in strapped black heels. Three pairs of wings spread behind her, dark navy feathered pairs plus long black mechanical blade-wings set with jetpacks. She carries a slim, needle-thin dark blade angled down at her side. While operating under the alias "Ramiel", she wears this look with a mask covering the lower half of her face.

**Feathered Murmurs (from the very end of v2.8 onwards):** The same face and pink hair, now pinned with a silver star-shaped clip and a lilac ribbon at the back, worn with an open, bright smile and a small violet choker set with a pale gem. Her dress is white and lilac, with an off-shoulder corset bodice laced up the front with violet ribbon and puffed white sleeves detached at the shoulder beneath grey pauldron rings. A long pleated white skirt panel falls over a lilac underskirt trailing ribbons. White thigh-highs run into lilac pearl-strapped heels. Her wings mirror the black set in pale colours, with white feathered pairs and long grey-white mechanical blade-wings lined with pink jetpacks, and she holds the same thin blade loosely at her side, the other hand extended in invitation.

**Combat Style (Lumiflux · Anomaly, S-Rank):** She is the first Lumiflux Agent in the game and the fourth Void Hunter to take the field, fighting with her Void Hunter Weapon Thaumiel as a flying, teleporting quickswap sub-DPS. Her damage runs on Attribute Flux, meaning her output synchronises with the attribute of the next Agent in the squad and can be tuned to whatever the enemy is weak to, and her exclusive Refringe reaction converts stacked Anomaly Buildup into a single high-burst detonation. Building Floating Radiance and swapping out sends her into Phase Flow, where she keeps fighting autonomously off-field, buffing the squad and layering on Lumiflux Buildup, before descending for her Assist: Flower & Feather Dance.

On-screen, she is a seraph with three pairs of wings: her own, plus Thaumiel's four mechanical razor wings, the lower pair small and bladed, the upper pair boosted like jetpacks with swords sheathed in them. Her signature power is temporal: she drops Ether activity in a person or a monster to near zero and petrifies them where they stand, marked by a single white feather settling on them as they go pale, and she can do this even unarmed. Render her as weightless aerial predation among drifting feathers, ending in the sudden, total silence of a world that has stopped moving. Every use of Thaumiel drags her further toward becoming an Enchainer herself.

194.comment: Agent BG · Remielle Dan — Void Hunter Era & Century in Stasis
194.content:
### 🪶 Remielle Dan · The Void Hunter Era and the Century in Stasis

Remielle's history is traumatic and complicated, and predates New Eridu's present day by more than a century.

**Before the weapons.** She was born over 100 years ago and belonged to the original generation of Void Hunters. She and Beliora Vike were childhood friends. Remielle was an accomplished dancer and was described as a prodigy at most things she tried. She was close to the other Void Hunters and was present when the Rosetta Data was first proven viable and when Sunbringer began prototyping the original Bangboo. The rabbit ears were her proposal, the one design of hers that survived into the final product after most of the rest were rejected. With Beliora and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe, she pushed the Dark Wall back by 37 kilometres.

**Thaumiel and Project Sunseeker.** After the Void Hunters brought down an Enchainer, its Karma Core was forged into the Void Hunter Weapons, and Remielle received Thaumiel. The weapons carried severe side effects, because their power stemmed from The Creator. When Arche and Sunbringer launched Project Sunseeker to merge the Void Hunters with their weapons' Karma Cores, meant to remove those costs and make them stronger still, she joined alongside Beliora. It ended in disaster: Beliora transformed into an Enchainer, and Remielle was forced to kill her.

**The stasis.** Remielle's own transformation into an Enchainer then began. It never completed, and the incomplete result locked her into a temporal stasis where she remained for the next century.

**Waking up.** About a year before Phaethon arrived in Roscaelifer, Remielle woke and immediately sealed Thaumiel away. She spent that year trying to acclimatise to a world that had moved on without her and investigating what had become of the other Void Hunters, which led her to fly to Roscaelifer looking for Sunbringer. She found Eldreda instead and confronted her over what had happened during Project Sunseeker, but left without an answer. The encounter was recorded as an attempted assassination and made her a wanted criminal in the city, and it convinced her she would need Thaumiel back to get any further. At some point, either straight out of stasis or later (it is unclear which), she joined the Covenant of Dayat.

195.content:
**Claret Flint · Director of Flint Workshop (Flint Workshop):** Head of the Flint family and Director of Flint Workshop, the Porcelloy research-and-manufacturing arm and one of Roscaelifer's five central departments. Her family has spent generations refining the craft of forging Porcelloy, which is what gives the Workshop its weight in the city. Because that craft is mentally and physically exhausting, she becomes furious when Porcelloy is wasted.

She is brash and narcissistic but earnest, with no filter on her opinions of people, and like anyone with a fragile ego, she is best handled by complimenting her and stroking it (though she gets pretend-annoyed if the flattery is laid on too thick). She has a direct connection to Phaethon: she supplied a substantial amount of the Porcelloy used in their treatment, having been sweet-talked into it by Dracaene ("innocent-faced little liar") while Dracaene chewed through three days of the Workshop's output. She still intends to settle that account with Dracaene.

Claret and Roxy grew up together around the three current Lady Sunbringers; Claret has long suspected that Lindverne is hiding something important from her, and at the end of Season 3 Chapter 3, she finds out she was right (see "S3 Ch3 · The Storm Has Yet to Settle (Sunbringer's Secret)"). Lindverne is also her biggest customer, since the Airspace Patrol runs on Porcelloy weapons, and the two of them are close friends who bicker constantly. Roxy's Porcelloy heart runs on regular doses of Claret's blood. In Season 3 Chapter 4, defending Eldreda against Phoenix's accusation, she let slip that Eldreda had commissioned an artificial Karma Core from the Workshop. Earlier, she had watched Lindverne conjure a combat mech out of thin air and declared it deeply unfair to anyone who designs things for a living, and afterwards, she stayed behind to hold Vyrium with Promeia and the Cunning Hares (see "S3 Ch4 · Let's Assassinate Eldreda Again! (Phoenix's Accusation)" and "S3 Ch4 · Return Ticket to the Horizon (Mechs Made by Genesis Reconstruction)"). She was first glimpsed in the Season 3 trailer "Before the Wind Rises", then met properly at the v3.1 tea party in Cuppa Moment alongside Lindverne and Sigrid, where she invited the Proxy to visit her workshop and look into their situation with Pyrois. Her signature line: "Let me educate you on something: the 'Flint' in front of Porcelloy isn't just there for show." In Season 3 Chapter 3, she went after her family's stolen Porcelloy at the Shrouded Reef in person, and after running her own blood over her hammer to forge it into a blood axe, she destroyed a TOPS mech built from that Porcelloy. Then, she fought Kusarikku beside Lindverne, Promeia and the Proxy under the research base (see "S3 Ch3 · Shrouded Reef Mystery (Into the Transfer Station)" and "S3 Ch3 · Kusarikku, the Replacement Sunbringer (Serpico Is Youkai)").

APPEARANCE: Her long blonde twintails are tied high with crimson ribbons and streaked with dark red strands, with a red headband and a small white bauble-and-bow ornament at one tie, above sharp red eyes, and her nails are painted dark red. A black lace choker sits beneath a white ruffled bib, over a black-and-white bustier laced down the front that leaves her midriff bare, with black cords criss-crossing her hips. Long black detached sleeves end in wide white cuffs fitted with curved white claw-blades at the wrists. Her black studded pleated skirt hangs from a red belt set with gems and is flanked by heavy silver hip plates, worn over sheer thigh-highs printed with small bats and a long draping panel that shades from grey into purple-red. Black lace-up heeled boots trimmed in red finish the look. She braces an enormous pole-axe diagonally across her body: a long black shaft ending in a needle spike above, and a huge crescent blade wreathed in glowing Etheric crimson below. Her whole design draws on vampire imagery.

**Combat Style (Electric · Armorer, S-Rank):** She was released in v3.2 "Their Secret Histories" as ZZZ's first **Armorer**, a Specialty for damage dealers whose skill multipliers scale off DEF instead of ATK, making defence and offence the same stat, and whose Energy gauge is replaced by **Sharpness**, which Energy Regen does not feed. Her Core Passive, *Banquet of Pale Blood*, rules that all of her skill damage counts as Sharp DMG and builds **Gash** on a target, stacking up to three. Her EX Special, *Bloodbloom Oath: Secret Forging Techniques*, spends 60 Sharpness to turn her forging hammer into the **Blood Axe** and drops her into **Crimson Inscription** for 16 seconds, during which her whole moveset becomes axe work. In that state, a tapped Special (*Cleaving Gold and Iron*) consumes one Gash to trigger **Maim**, a heavy AoE detonation, while a held Special (*Blood Burial Assault*) chains up to three Maims in a row. Her enhanced Basic, *Starforging*, is an extendable flurry of slashes that can be released early into a leaping downward smash, with Perfect Dodges triggered mid-air and fed straight back into the combo. Her crits work unlike anyone else's. Sharp DMG ignores the CRIT DMG Bonus and applies **Laceration DMG** instead, and CRIT Rate above 100% rolls a second, multiplicative Laceration check. Every 1% of her initial CRIT DMG is converted into 0.35% initial CRIT Rate, so she wants DEF and CRIT Rate where other carries want ATK and CRIT DMG. Her Chain Attack (*Resonant Blood Pact*) extends Crimson Inscription; her Ultimate (*Trial After Trial*) refunds Sharpness. Her Armorer-exclusive Counter Assist, "Give Not an Inch of Steel", locks an enemy into a power struggle and neutralises boss Control Skills outright, with a follow-up that hammers another Gash stack into the target. Her Additional Ability, *Bloodline Legacy*, hands every Armorer in the squad **Remnant Edge** whenever anyone triggers Maim. Render her as a vampiric blacksmith at work: sparks, forge-heat, blood-red arcs of Electric, and an axe swung like a hammer coming down on an anvil.

196.comment: Agent BG · Roxy Ifrita Pryce (Flint Workshop)
196.content:
**Roxanne "Roxy" Ifrita Pryce · Chief Smith, Flint Workshop:** Claret Flint's most trusted assistant and the Workshop's chief smith. She is the reserved, calm counterpoint to Claret's noise and is fiercely loyal to her. The two have known each other since childhood, having grown up together around Roscaelifer's three Lady Sunbringers, so their working relationship is far older and more equal than the titles of director and assistant suggest. (The suggestive closeness under the table inside Claret's guest villa that she warned the Proxies not to talk about heavily suggest they may be a lesbian couple, but that remains unconfirmed.)

Roxy is the one who keeps the forge running day to day. She is also the Workshop's resident manager and, in practice, Claret's housekeeper and problem-solver, and she calls Claret "milady". She thinks of herself as an ordinary hard worker trying to keep pace with geniuses like Claret and Norma, and she stays calm in a crisis because milady gets into more than enough trouble for both of them. Her humour is dry and funereal: coffins come up in her conversation far more often than anyone asked for, and her kit's skill names read like the courtesies of an undertaker. She hasn't enjoyed a worry-free night's sleep in a long time. Push her plans through enough of Claret's last-minute changes and she finally snaps, at which point Vyrium gains a terrifying figure who roams its streets late at night.

**The Porcelloy Heart.** Roxy's own heart was replaced with Porcelloy, and Porcelloy grafted into a body runs on Flint blood, so she needs regular transfusions from the Flint family to stay alive, most of them from Claret. When she gets dizzy, Claret's finger is the nearest first aid, which is exactly what the Proxies walked in on at Claret's villa in Season 3 Chapter 3. Overwork has made the paleness of her condition worse. Some people in Vyrium whisper that she only stays at the head of the family's side to keep her heart running, and that the Flint blood bought the Workshop a capable assistant; she has heard it so often that she no longer bothers to deny it.
